Learn more about permissions in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: permissions; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/your-account/staff-accounts]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/new-editing-features-for-shopify-email; date: March 12, 2021; title: New editing features for Shopify Email; areas: [Apps]; text: We've revamped the Shopify Email editor with new features to make it easier to level up your email creativity—This includes product grids, button styling and a divider section. Product Grids are a simple way for merchants to add multiple products in columns and rows to their email campaigns. You can customize the style of buttons and add a divider anywhere in the email. Learn more about the new editing features from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Help Center; href: https://utm.guru/uc7t5]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/cancel-a-return-is-now-available; date: March 09, 2021; title: Cancel a return is now available; areas: [Orders]; text: Managing returns is an essential part of the customer experience. But just like any other order action, mistakes can happen or a buyer can change their mind about returning your product. That's why we’ve added the ability to cancel a return in Shopify. You can cancel a return after a return request has been initiated, giving you the flexibility to accommodate changes or restart the return if a mistake has been made. To learn more about returns, visit the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Help Center; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/orders/refund-cancel-order]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/the-geolocation-app-now-supports-regions; date: March 08, 2021; title: The Geolocation app now supports regions; areas: [Apps]; text: Buyers expect to select their region when buying internationally, not their currency. That's why the Geolocation app has been improved to offer your buyers intelligent country & region recommendations and selectors: This is especially useful for stores that sell to to multiple regions that use the same currency (for example, within the Eurozone). If you set different prices for specific regions using international pricing, then the Geolocation app can now accurately guide your buyers to the right price for their region. Learn more about the Geolocation app from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Geolocation app; href: https://apps.shopify.com/geolocation | text: international pricing; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments/multi-currency/international-pricing | text: Geolocation app; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/cross-border/geolocation]; media: [tag: img; src: https://screenshot.click/08-38-fn85p-ny5kr.gif]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/control-pricing-by-region-with-international-pricing; date: March 08, 2021; title: Control pricing by region with international pricing; areas: [Payments]; text: If you use Shopify Payments, then you can now control your prices by region using international pricing: - On the Shopify plan or higher, you can use percentage price adjustments to increase or decrease prices across your entire store in certain countries or regions. - On the Advanced and Shopify Plus plans, you can upload specific prices per product, per country using a csv file. You can continue to use automatic or manual FX rates for different currencies and customize your business's rounding rules to control how the final prices appear in your online store. Learn more about international pricing from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: international pricing; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments/multi-currency/international-pricing]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/enable-passwordless-login-at-pos-pro-locations; date: March 08, 2021; title: Enable passwordless login at POS Pro locations; areas: [POS]; text: Store owners, or admin staff who have the permissions to initialize POS, can now generate and send QR codes that store staff can use to log in to POS devices quickly and securely at POS Pro locations. No sharing of passwords is necessary. Through the Point of Sale channel of the Shopify admin, authorized admin staff can generate QR codes that correspond to Pro locations. Codes can be emailed to store staff who can use them to initialize or log in to POS devices at a particular location. If initalizing multiple devices, a new code must be generated for each device, and each code is valid for 8 hours. Learn more about setting up QR code logins for Pro locations from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: setting up QR code logins for Pro locations; href: http://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/staff-management/qr-code]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/google-recaptcha-for-customer-login; date: March 04, 2021; title: Google recaptcha for customer login; areas: [Online Store]; text: Minimize abusive bot traffic on your online store by enabling Google recaptcha for customer login, account, and password pages. Learn more about enabling or disabling recaptcha from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: enabling or disabling recaptcha; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/online-store/os/preferences#enable-or-disable-recaptcha-v3-for-contact-forms]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/express-v1-11-0; date: March 01, 2021; title: Express V1.11.0; tags: [text: Improvement]; areas: [Online Store]; text: Version 1.11.0 of Express is now available on the Shopify Theme Store. Version 1.11.0 introduces the following features: New Banner section: Create visual impact in your store and highlight your brand. You can also use the new banner section to advertise a promotion, or feature a product or collection. New multi-column section: Add up to four columns of content in a single section on your home page. Pickup availability: Show customers whether a product in your online store is available for local pickup on your product pages. New collection display settings: Display a collection's image and description in your featured collections sections and your collection pages. New style settings: Pick between sharp and rounded edge styles for elements such as buttons, badges and cards. New announcement bar settings: Add a URL to the announcement bar in your header. Learn more about these features in the Express theme manual. Express version 1.11.0 is now available in the Shopify Theme Store. All merchants who are currently using Express and are eligible for an upgrade will be upgraded over the week of March 1.; links: [text: Pickup availability; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shipping/setting-up-and-managing-your-shipping/local-methods/local-pickup#show-pickup-availability-to-your-customers | text: Express theme manual; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/online-store/os/using-themes/themes-by-shopify/express]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/more-bulk-order-actions-added-to-the-shopify-mobile-app; date: February 26, 2021; title: More bulk order actions added to the Shopify mobile app; areas: [Mobile]; text: Order management on mobile lets you process orders from the palm of your hand as you pick, pack and prepare orders for delivery. We've added four more bulk order actions to the mobile experience, so that you can fulfill orders more efficiently. You can now use the following bulk order actions: * Print packing slips * Add tags * Remove tags * Take an action with a Shopify app Learn more about bulk actions from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: bulk actions; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-admin/productivity-tools/bulk-actions]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/embed-vimeo-videos-on-product-pages; date: February 24, 2021; title: Embed Vimeo videos on product pages; areas: [Products]; text: You can now add Vimeo-hosted videos to your products, giving you more options for displaying media on product pages. Using product media lets your customers see what your products look like and gives them a better idea of how they appear in real life. Learn more about adding product media in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: adding product media; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/products/product-media/add-media]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/organization-names-in-shopify-organization-admin-urls; date: February 23, 2021; title: Organization names in Shopify organization admin URLs; areas: [Plus]; text: We’ve updated the Shopify.Plus URL to a more meaningful format, making the URL easier to remember and share. The new URL replaces the segment that contains the organization ID with a string generated from the organization’s name. The previous URL containing organization ID will redirect to the new URL format. Learn more about the Shopify organization admin from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify organization admin; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shopify-plus]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/oberlo-becomes-different-currency-friendly; date: February 22, 2021; title: Oberlo becomes different currency friendly; text: You can now use the Oberlo app in the same currency that's set in your Shopify admin. This means that you no longer need to manually convert product costs and prices from USD to your target currency – everything is now converted by Oberlo. To learn more about selling in other than the USD currency, visit the Oberlo Help Center.; links: [text: Oberlo Help Center; href: https://help.oberlo.com/en/articles/952395-selling-in-other-currencies]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/shopify-flow-adds-support-for-liquid-filters-url_encode-and-json-in-http-actions; date: February 18, 2021; title: Shopify Flow adds support for liquid filters url_encode and json in HTTP actions; areas: [Plus]; text: To ensure your HTTP requests are as secure as possible, we’ve added two liquid filters to be used in an HTTP action: You can now use | url_encode to any liquid variables in the path section of the HTTP action URL configuration field. The web server that receives the request must support decoding urls. Add either | url_encode or | json to each template variable that is used in the body section of the HTTP action body configuration field. The web server that receives the request must support decoding URLs or JSON decoding. Learn more about using these filters to improve your HTTP request security and find examples from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: improve your HTTP request security; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shopify-plus/flow/create-workflow/messages/http-requests#security]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/browsing-and-buying-on-shop; date: February 16, 2021; title: Browsing and buying on Shop; areas: [Shop]; text: Buyers browsing your products from the Shop app now enjoy an enhanced in-app experience thanks to more fully featured product pages in Shop. Additionally, a new Buy now button on products listed in Shop can reduce friction for buyers and potentially drive repeat purchases from your store. The new experience is available for buyers in the US, Canada, UK and Australia on select stores. Learn more about your products in Shop from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shop; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/online-sales-channels/shop]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/shopify-scripts-x-subscription-apps; date: February 15, 2021; title: Shopify Scripts x Subscription Apps; areas: [Plus]; text: You can now use Subscription Apps on Shopify Plus stores that utilize Shopify Scripts. Learn more about Shopify Scripts from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Subscription Apps; href: https://apps.shopify.com/browse/sales-and-conversion-optimization-subscriptions | text: Shopify Scripts; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/checkout-settings/script-editor]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/simplified-tax-registrations-for-australia-new-zealand-switzerland-and-norway; date: February 08, 2021; title: Simplified tax registrations for Australia, New Zealand, Switzerland, and Norway; areas: [Admin]; text: Keeping your tax rates up to date and knowing how much tax to charge on sales can be time consuming, so we've streamlined the experience to make it faster and easier. When you add information in your store's tax settings about your registrations in Australia, New Zealand, Switzerland, or Norway, the tax rates that apply in the areas that you have registered for are automatically set - no more manually updating rates, no more deciding what rates to set based on your sales tax liability! Learn more about setting up location-based taxes for your store from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: location-based taxes; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/taxes/location-based]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/offer-automatic-discounts-at-point-of-sale-with-pos-pro; date: February 08, 2021; title: Offer automatic discounts at point of sale with POS Pro; areas: [POS]; text: Offer customers a consistent shopping experience, and bring speed and accuracy to your in-store checkout with automatic discounts, now available on Shopify POS with a POS Pro subscription. For stores using POS Pro, you can offer automatic percentage, fixed amount, or buy X get Y discounts to retail customers by selecting Also offer on Point of Sale. When you select the option to share the automatic discount, it's available to all Pro retail locations. Learn more about setting up automatic discounts for POS from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: setting up automatic discounts for POS; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/discounts/automatic-discounts]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/create-orders-directly-from-the-customer-page; date: January 29, 2021; title: Create orders directly from the customer page; areas: [Customers]; text: You can now pre-fill a draft order with the customer's address and contact information directly from the customer page. This makes creating orders for repeat customers even simpler. Learn more about creating orders for customers from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: creating orders for customers; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/customers/customer-service#creating-orders-for-customers]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/new-shopify-flow-trigger-for-subscriptions; date: January 28, 2021; title: New Shopify Flow trigger for subscriptions!; areas: [Plus]; text: We’ve added a new trigger to Shopify Flow for when subscription contracts are created. The new trigger starts when a customer buys a subscription-based product. Learn more about Shopify Flow from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Flow; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/flow/]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/access-detailed-insights-into-retail-store-performance-with-enhanced-pos-analytics; date: January 27, 2021; title: Access detailed insights into retail store performance with enhanced POS analytics; areas: [POS]; text: POS analytics, available as a part of POS Pro, now include the following new reports to help you better understand store performance over time: Product report to see top selling products (by net sales or units sold) over time Product type report to see top selling product types (by net sales or units sold) over time Staff report to see top-performing staff by net sales over time Payments report to see net sales by payment type over time Gift cards report to see net sales by gift card over time Learn more about Shopify POS analytics in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify POS analytics; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/analytics-on-pos]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/upgrade-your-customized-checkout; date: January 25, 2021; title: Upgrade your customized checkout; areas: [Plus]; text: Stores with checkout.liquid enabled can now upgrade to a new version of Shopify Checkout, unlocking powerful new checkout features—like subscription apps and local pickup—while keeping their checkout.liquid customizations intact. All checkout upgrades need to be completed by February 26, 2021. Stores that don’t complete the upgrade within the checkout upgrade window (January 25, 2021 to February 26, 2021) will be upgraded automatically, which might cause some customizations to break. Find instructions for the checkout upgrade process in the Shopify help center. Only stores with checkout.liquid enabled need to perform the upgrade.; links: [text: Shopify help center; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/checkout-settings/checkout-upgrade]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/make-shipping-speeds-available-to-your-customers-at-checkout-1; date: January 25, 2021; title: Make shipping speeds available to your customers at checkout; areas: [Shipping]; text: Communicating shipping speeds at checkout to your customers can help improve cart conversion, and provide clarity and transparency so that your customers are more confident making purchases because they know when their packages will arrive. When you add shipping speeds to your shipping rates in Shipping and Delivery Settings, your customers will see a range of days at checkout that will reflect the estimated transit time of their purchase. This will be automatically estimated without you having to do any manual calculations! Learn about adding shipping speeds to your shipping rates from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: adding shipping speeds to your shipping rates; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shipping/setting-up-and-managing-your-shipping/shipping-speeds]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/local-delivery-now-supports-cross-state-deliveries-multiple-zones-and-customized-pricing-conditions; date: January 22, 2021; title: Local delivery now supports cross-state deliveries, multiple zones, and customized pricing conditions; areas: [Shipping]; text: We’ve recently updated local delivery to give you more flexible options when it comes to setting your delivery zones and creating your pricing conditions. Local-delivery now supports cross-states (or cross-regions). By default, local deliveries are restricted to the location state/region. Now, you can configure local delivery based on distance, so that you can enable this service for adjacent states and regions. Multiple delivery zones are also now available for local delivery. You can create up to five delivery zones, allowing you to reach a wider base of local delivery customers. These zones can be created either using select postal codes or a delivery radius. Additionally, you can create one or more custom pricing conditions within each zone based on order value or delivery distance. The buyer will see the cheapest delivery fee that is relevant to them at checkout based on their location and cart price. Learn more about local delivery from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Help Center; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shipping/setting-up-and-managing-your-shipping/local-methods/local-delivery]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/express-v1-10-0; date: January 22, 2021; title: Express: V1.10.0; tags: [text: Improvement]; areas: [Online Store]; text: Version 1.10.0 of Express is now available on the Shopify Theme Store. This update introduces a new page section for the home page. The new section enables you to feature content from a page, like your About Us or Contact page, directly on the homepage. This feature only surfaces the content that was added by using the rich text editor for that page. A mass upgrade is planned to go out in a few days for stores using Express that can be automatically updated. To learn more about the page section, visit the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Help Center; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/online-store/os/using-themes/themes-by-shopify/express/sections#page]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/fulfill-orders-more-efficiently-with-the-shopify-mobile-app; date: January 22, 2021; title: Fulfill orders more efficiently with the Shopify mobile app; areas: [Mobile]; text: Order management on mobile lets you process orders from the palm of your hand as you pick, pack and prepare orders for delivery. Now available is the ability to use bulk actions for order and fulfillment tasks, so that you can bring more flexibility and speed to your fulfillment process and get products to customers faster. Bulk order actions on mobile include: Mark as fulfilled Capture payment Archive products Unarchive products Create shipping labels (US, Canada, and Australia only) Learn more about bulk actions in order fulfillment from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Help Center; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/orders/fulfillment/fulfilling-orders/fulfill-your-own#fulfill-multiple-orders-at-the-same-time]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/new-shopify-flow-trigger-for-product-statuses; date: January 19, 2021; title: New Shopify Flow trigger for product statuses!; areas: [Plus]; text: With the recent release of product statuses we've added a new trigger "Product status updated". Use this trigger to build automated workflows that begin when a product’s status changes to another state including draft, active, and archived. Learn more about Shopify Flow from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: product statuses; href: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/manage-your-products-with-statuses | text: Shopify Flow; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shopify-plus/flow]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/create-a-scan-form-with-the-shipping-manifests-app; date: January 19, 2021; title: Create a SCAN form with the Shipping Manifests app; areas: [Shipping]; text: You can now to create and print USPS SCAN forms using the Shipping Manifests app. With a SCAN form, multiple USPS shipping labels can be linked under a single barcode, making package drop-off or pickup quick and safe. Learn more about Shipping Manifests from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shipping Manifests; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shipping/shopify-shipping/shipping-labels/manifests]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/new-performant-font-options-for-themes; date: January 14, 2021; title: New performant font options for themes; areas: [Themes]; text: We’ve released a new font picker for the theme editor. The new font picker lets you choose system fonts for elements in your theme. Using system fonts in your theme avoids downloading extra resources to your customer’s computer, which can decrease the time your store takes to load. Learn more about how fonts can improve performance in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Learn more about how fonts can improve performance; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/online-store/os/store-speed/improving-speed#fonts]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/discover-and-diners-club-cards-accepted-for-shopify-payments-in-canada; date: January 14, 2021; title: Discover and Diners Club cards accepted for Shopify Payments in Canada; areas: [Payments]; text: For stores using Shopify Payments in Canada, Diners Club and Discover card payments are now accepted credit cards. Learn more about Shopify Payments from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Payments; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/payments/shopify-payments]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/manage-your-products-with-statuses; date: January 11, 2021; title: Manage your products with statuses; areas: [Products]; text: Product statuses help you manage and organize products as you're getting ready to sell them, or retiring the ones you no longer sell. Use the draft product status to work on products at your own pace until you're ready to make them available. Once you've got all of the details down, set the product status as active, so your products can be made available to customers through selected sales channels and apps. Use archive for products that you no longer sell to keep your product lists organized and free from clutter without losing the information for these products. Learn more about product status from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: product status; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/products/add-update-products]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/checkout-upgrade-for-plus-shops-using-checkout-liquid; date: January 06, 2021; title: Checkout upgrade for Plus shops using checkout.liquid; areas: [Plus]; text: The next checkout upgrade will take place between January 25, 2021 to February 26, 2021. On the Shopify Plus plan, you get exclusive access to the checkout.liquid file, enabling you to make flexible customizations to Shopify Checkout. However, you need to upgrade Shopify Checkout periodically in order to unlock new features while ensuring your checkout.liquid customizations remain in-tact. Only shops with checkout.liquid enabled need to perform the upgrade. Learn more about the checkout upgrade process and view a full list of the new Shopify Checkout features in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: checkout upgrade process; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/checkout-settings/checkout-upgrade]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/changes-to-collection-of-vat-for-orders-to-the-united-kingdom; date: December 31, 2020; title: Changes to collection of VAT for orders to the United Kingdom; areas: [Admin]; text: As of January 1, 2021 (GMT), the following changes apply to the movement of goods to and from the United Kingdom: Merchants shipping goods located outside of the UK at the point of sale into the UK are now required to collect and remit VAT on orders not exceeding £135 in value. Merchants who have an active tax registration for the UK in Shopify will now automatically collect VAT on all orders not exceeding £135. Orders over £135 will continue to exclude all taxes. VAT will no longer be automatically applied on orders shipped between the UK and European Union countries (and vice versa) if there is no tax registration added. Learn more about this change and other changes related to Brexit in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: required to collect and remit VAT; href: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/changes-to-vat-treatment-of-overseas-goods-sold-to-customers-from-1-january-2021/changes-to-vat-treatment-of-overseas-goods-sold-to-customers-from-1-january-2021#goods-located-outside-the-uk-at-the-point-of-sale | text: Shopify Help Center; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/taxes/eu/uk#vat]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/store-session-and-conversion-rate-kpi-s-in-overview-analytics; date: December 21, 2020; title: Store session and conversion rate KPI's in Overview analytics; areas: [Plus]; text: To help you understand better the health of your business, we're introducing additional key performance indicator store metrics in the Overview analytics for Plus stores. If you have multiple stores, then you can see an overview of key metrics for all your stores in one central place. Learn more about Overview analytics from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Overview analytics; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shopify-plus/overview]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/merchants-can-now-configure-country-specific-tax-inclusive-pricing; date: December 18, 2020; title: Merchants can now configure country specific tax inclusive pricing; areas: [Checkout]; text: Merchants with prices inclusive of tax can now charge the correct price at checkout based on their tax obligations when shipping to buyers in different countries. screenshot of the Include or exclude tax based on your customer's country setting This is particularly useful for merchants who ship to different countries and have their shop configured to use tax inclusive pricing, who want to see prices at checkout correctly reflect the VAT/tax rate of their buyers. Learn more about the change and how to enable it on the Shopify Help Centre.; links: [text: Shopify Help Centre; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/taxes/location-based#include-or-exclude-tax-based-on-your-customers-country]; media: [tag: img; src: https://screenshot.click/16-33-k2ird-jgpmh.png]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/accept-interac-chip-pin-at-canadian-retail-stores; date: December 14, 2020; title: Accept Interac Chip & PIN at Canadian retail stores; areas: [POS]; text: Interac Chip & PIN can now be accepted by to Canadian stores using Shopify’s Tap & Chip Reader with Shopify POS. You can now accept Interac payments for all transactions, regardless of dollar amount or tap limits, and at a cost of only $0.10 per transaction. Learn more about the Tap & Chip Reader and Interac from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Tap & Chip Reader; href: https://hardware.shopify.ca/products/shopify-tap-chip-card-reader?itcat=pos-hardware&itterm=pos-hardware-hardware-card-readers-learn-more | text: Tap & Chip Reader and Interac; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/hardware/card-readers/tap-chip]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/daily-sales-tiles-offer-more-time-based-views-for-the-pos-daily-sales-report; date: November 30, 2020; title: Daily Sales tiles offer more time-based views for the POS Daily Sales report; areas: [POS]; text: New Daily Sales tiles at the top of the POS Daily Sales report, available through POS Pro, make it easier to see whether your store is on pace to meet or exceed your sales targets. You can now track each retail location's performance over time with new time-based views (Today, Yesterday, Week to Date, Month to Date, Quarter to Date, and Year to Date) for top-level metrics like Net sales, Average order value, and Items per order. Learn more about the POS Daily Sales report and Daily Sales tiles in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: POS Daily Sales report and Daily Sales tiles; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/analytics-on-pos]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/watch-bfcm-2020-in-real-time-with-live-map; date: November 27, 2020; title: Watch BFCM 2020 in real-time with Live Map; areas: [Analytics]; text: Watch BFCM 2020 unfold in real-time with the BFCM Live Map. This year, the Live Map was completely rebuilt with a few major improvements to reflect the scale and shared success of more than 1 million independent businesses powered by Shopify. Explore the Live Map to watch key milestones such as: Sales per minute Orders per minute ? Carbon offsets made through our BFCM offset commitment View the BFCM Live Map; links: [text: BFCM offset commitment; href: https://www.shopify.com/blog/bfcm-carbon-offsets | text: BFCM Live Map; href: https://datastories.shopify.com/?itcat=blog&itterm=383054184482]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/watch-your-store-activity-come-to-life-in-real-time-with-live-view; date: November 25, 2020; title: Watch your store activity come to life in real time with Live View; areas: [Analytics]; text: We’ve improved the Live View to provide an immersive real time look at activity across your store so you can stay up to date on your store’s performance. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/carbon-neutral-bfcm-shopping; date: November 13, 2020; title: Carbon-neutral BFCM shopping; areas: [Shipping]; text: This year, Shopify is paying to offset all carbon emissions from the delivery of every single order placed on our platform during the BFCM weekend. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/fixed-amount-discounts-now-use-manual-fx-rates-when-selling-in-multiple-currencies; date: November 02, 2020; title: Fixed amount discounts now use manual FX rates when selling in multiple currencies; areas: [Discounts]; text: When selling in multiple currencies using Shopify Payments, fixed discount amounts are now converted from your shop currency into the buyer's currency according to the pricing rule you have set up for that currency; either manual or automatic FX rates. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/manage-returns-directly-in-shopify; date: October 28, 2020; title: Manage returns directly in Shopify; areas: [Orders]; text: The product return process is an essential part of the customer experience. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/apply-bulk-discount-settings-in-shopify-launchpad; date: October 27, 2020; title: Apply bulk discount settings in Shopify Launchpad; areas: [Plus]; text: We’ve made creating discount events in Shopify Launchpad easier! uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/make-more-informed-inventory-decisions-with-abc-analysis; date: October 01, 2020; title: Make more informed inventory decisions with ABC analysis; areas: [Analytics]; text: We’ve added a new inventory report to Shopify - ABC analysis by product. This report can be used to identify your best and worst performing inventory over the past 28 days. A grade is your best performing inventory and represents the specific inventory that accounts for 80% of your revenue. B grade is your middle of the road inventory and represents the specific inventory that accounts for the next 15% of your revenue. C grade identifies your worst performing inventory and represents the specific inventory that accounts for the remaining 5% of your revenue. This analysis is designed to help you optimize your investment in inventory by understanding which products to purchase and which products to avoid. With ABC analysis, you can continuously monitor the value of your stock, so you can make better decisions about your inventory. The ABC analysis by product report is available to all merchants on the Shopify plan or above. Learn more about the ABC analysis by product report from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: ABC analysis by product report; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/inventory/abc-analysis]

In addition to Allowed or Denied, new POS Permissions come with a third access level: Approval required, which means that a staff member’s ability to perform an action requires explicit approval from another member of staff. Manager approval is available for the following permissions: * Apply discount * Ship to customer * Edit taxes * Add custom sales * Refund and exchange orders See a full list of POS permissions and learn more about setting up manager approvals for your store in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: manager approvals; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/staff-management/pos-roles]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/simplified-eu-uk-tax-registrations; date: September 01, 2020; title: Simplified EU/UK tax registrations; areas: [Admin]; text: Keeping your tax rates up to date and knowing how much VAT to charge on sales in different EU countries and the UK can be time consuming, so we've streamlined the experience to make it faster and easier. In your taxes settings, when you provide the information about where you're registered in the EU or UK, Shopify automatically sets the tax rates that apply in the areas you've registered for - no more manually updating rates, no more deciding what rates to set based on your sales tax liability! Learn more about setting up EU taxes using the new feature from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: EU taxes; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/taxes/eu/eu-tax-migrate]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/product-recommendations-in-shopify-pos; date: September 01, 2020; title: Product recommendations in Shopify POS; areas: [POS]; text: Product recommendations in Shopify POS enable you to leverage online insights to drive consistency, confidence, and conversion in your offline selling. Data-backed, just-in-time product recommendations on the POS home screen, individual product pages, and customer profiles create cross-sell and upsell opportunities that make it easy for staff to personalize buyer experiences and make smarter recommendations that are guaranteed to increase cart sizes and sales — wherever your customers choose to shop. Product recommendations are available as a POS extension through select Shopify app partners. Learn more about setting up product recommendations in POS in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: select Shopify app partners; href: https://apps.shopify.com/collections/pos-product-recommendations | text: product recommendations in POS; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos/getting-started/shopify-pos-from-admin/embedded-apps#access-embedded-apps-in-shopify-pos]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/expand-globally-with-international-domains; date: August 27, 2020; title: Expand globally with International Domains; areas: [Online Store]; text: Merchants can now add and assign individual domains to a country to offer an improved localized buying experience for international buyers. When buyers land on the country domain, they will automatically see the store in their local currency and language. International domains rely on merchants selling in multiple currencies with Shopify Payments, and translation via compatible 3rd party translations app. This feature is available to merchants on the Shopify, Advanced, and Plus plans. Learn more about international domains from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Payments; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments/multi-currency | text: 3rd party translations app; href: https://apps.shopify.com/collections/apps-for-store-languages | text: international domains; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/domains/managing-domains/international-domains]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/added-order-cancelled-trigger-to-shopify-flow; date: August 26, 2020; title: Added `Order Cancelled` trigger to Shopify Flow; areas: [Plus]; text: A new trigger has been added to Shopify Flow. You can use the trigger Order Cancelled to create workflows that will be started when you cancel an order. Learn more about Shopify Flow from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Flow; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/flow]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/automated-order-lookup-in-shopify-chat; date: August 26, 2020; title: Automated Order Lookup in Shopify Chat; areas: [Apps]; text: We've just released an automated flow for customers to get the status of their recent orders using Shopify Chat on your online store. ? This new feature allows customers to provide their order number and email address and receive an automated response that includes the fulfillment status of their order, and a tracking link or order status link. In Ping you will see these conversations as automated messages in your inbox, and you will be notified if the customer sends a follow-up message and needs further assistance. This feature is enabled for all users of Shopify Chat. Learn more about automated order lookup in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: automated order lookup; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/ping/shopify-chat#customer-experience]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/three-new-delete-triggers-for-shopify-flow; date: August 26, 2020; title: Three new delete triggers for Shopify Flow; areas: [Plus]; text: Three new triggers have been added to Shopify Flow: order deleted, customer deleted, and product deleted. You can trigger a workflow using one of these three triggers by deleting an order, customer or product. Learn more about Shopify Flow from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Flow; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/flow]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/add-is-any-of-and-is-not-any-of-to-more-field-types-in-shopify-flow; date: August 26, 2020; title: Add `is any of` and `is not any of` to more field types in Shopify Flow; areas: [Plus]; text: Shopify Flow now includes the operator is any of and is not any of to more field types! You can now use the operator on ENUM and Number fields such as orders's currencyCode or customer's orderCount. To use the operator, add commas between the values that you want to compare against. For example, you could enter CA,US to check whether an order's currencyCode is either Canada or USA. Learn more about Shopify Flow from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Flow; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/flow]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/a-more-local-address-form-experience-in-checkout; date: August 19, 2020; title: A more local address form experience in checkout ?; areas: [Checkout]; text: To help you capture accurate shipping addresses with the details needed to fulfill orders successfully and build trust with your buyers by meeting their local expectations, we've made improvements to the address form experience in checkout. The following changes are included: localized address form labels for Germany, Spain, Italy, China, Japan, Hong Kong, Brazil, Netherlands, Switzerland, Austria, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, and Mexico re-ordered zip code fields for Spain, Italy, Austria, Switzerland, Denmark, Norway, Netherlands, and Sweden a prompt to add a house number if missed for Germany, Spain, Italy, The Netherlands, Austria, Switzerland, Brazil, and Mexico Now your customers will enjoy a more familiar checkout, no matter where they're located.

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/country-fields-in-checkout-brazil; date: August 19, 2020; title: Country Fields in Checkout (Brazil); areas: [Checkout]; text: Shopify now supports the ability for Brazilian Merchants to collect CPF/CNPJ information at checkout using built in functionality. This ensure that merchants are able to collect country specific information from buyers in countries where this additional information is a requirement (e.g. Brazilian tax IDs from Brazilian buyers). Learn more about country fields in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: country fields; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/checkout-settings/order-processing#enable-country-specific-information-fields]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/create-and-manage-user-roles-in-the-plus-admin; date: August 18, 2020; title: Create and manage user roles in the Plus admin; areas: [Plus]; text: Save hours of administrative time with Users Roles in the Plus Admin. Efficiently and securely manage staff by creating consistent permissions and access for specific roles within your organization. This is exclusive to Shopify Plus merchants with access to user management in the Plus Admin. Learn more about setting Roles for user permissions in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: setting Roles for user permissions; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shopify-plus/users/user-roles]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/important-changes-to-new-development-stores; date: August 17, 2020; title: Important changes to new development stores; areas: [Partners]; text: Starting on August 17, 2020, all newly created development stores will be password protected. Moving forward, Partners will not be able to disable the password page unless they transfer the store to a merchant or select a plan. This means that visitors to development stores will need to enter a password to view the store. App and theme developers can still use development stores for App and Theme Store listings. You don't need to change any settings on the store to enable this functionality. Existing development stores are not impacted. This update ensures the best experience of Shopify for merchants, buyers and our Partners. Learn more about password-protected development stores in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: password-protected development stores; href: https://help.shopify.com/partners/dashboard/managing-stores/development-stores]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/monitor-workflows-in-shopify-flow-with-search-and-filtering-options; date: August 13, 2020; title: Monitor workflows in Shopify Flow with search and filtering options; areas: [Plus]; text: Monitoring workflow runs in Shopify Flow now provides search and filter options giving you a clearer picture of your automated tasks. On the Workflow summary page in Flow the Recent activity and Recent results cards have been replaced by a single Workflow runs card which has granular filtering options and search capabilities. You can now search by run ID as well as filter by date and status (In progress, Succeeded with actions, Succeeded without actions, and Failed). Learn more about monitoring workflows from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: monitoring workflows; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shopify-plus/flow/monitor-workflow]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/offer-local-delivery-at-checkout-with-optimized-delivery-routes; date: July 31, 2020; title: Offer local delivery at checkout with optimized delivery routes ?; areas: [Products]; text: Delivering your products locally is a powerful way to connect with your community through thoughtful shopping experiences and to help generate sales and revenue. That’s why we built tools to help you manage your entire local delivery flow from checkout through to a delivered order. Set up local delivery at checkout. You can define your delivery prices, set delivery zones, and set a minimum order that qualifies for local delivery. Install the Shopify Local Delivery app to create optimized delivery routes and share them with drivers. Give drivers the ability to access directions, send notifications, and update delivery statuses while you manage deliveries in real-time. You and your delivery staff can download the Shopify Local Delivery mobile app on iOS or Android to connect drivers to optimized routes and get orders to customers faster. Learn more about Local Delivery from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: local delivery; href: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/local-delivery-is-now-available | text: Shopify Local Delivery app; href: apps.shopify.com/local-delivery | text: iOS; href: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/shopify-local-delivery/id1524432567 | text: Android; href: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.shopify.localdelivery | text: Local Delivery; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/apps/apps-by-shopify/local-delivery-app]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/find-out-how-fast-your-store-is-with-a-new-online-store-speed-report; date: July 28, 2020; title: Find out how fast your store is with a new Online store speed report; areas: [Admin]; text: Online store speed is an important factor in your search ranking, providing your customers the shopping experience they expect, and increasing your conversion rate - but it can be hard to make time to do the analysis and understand how your store speed stacks up. The new Online store speed report runs speed tests for your home page and highest-traffic collection and product pages, and then combines each page’s Google Lighthouse speed score into one speed score. You’ll also get a comparison of how your store’s speed compares to similar online stores. The Online store speed report will roll out to all merchants over the coming weeks. Learn more about your online store speed and how to make informed decisions with speed in mind from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Google Lighthouse; href: https://developers.google.com/web/tools/lighthouse/ | text: Shopify Help Center; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/online-store/legacy/store-speed/]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/manual-exchange-rates-for-shopify-payments; date: July 21, 2020; title: Manual exchange rates for Shopify Payments; areas: [Payments]; text: Merchants can now set manual exchange rates for international currencies with Shopify Payments. Products will now have stable prices in other currencies which do not change with market exchange rates. Similar to automatic exchange rates, merchants can continue to round their prices up for a consistent pricing presentation. Manual exchange rates is now available to merchants on the Shopify, Advanced, and Plus plans. Learn more about manual exchange rates from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: manual exchange rates; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments/multi-currency/conversions#manual-exchange-rate-conversions]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/recaptcha-v3-on-online-store-built-in-contact-forms-blog-comments; date: July 17, 2020; title: ReCAPTCHA v3 on Online Store built-in contact forms & blog comments; areas: [Online Store]; text: Google’s reCAPTCHA v3 has been added to online store contact forms and blog comments to reduce incoming spam. reCAPTCHA v3 analyzes visitor behavior to block spam from bots, and reduces friction for real users by eliminating CAPTCHA challenges. This feature is enabled by on all stores by default, but can be disabled in your online store preferences. Learn more about reCAPTCHA v3 in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: reCAPTCHA v3; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/online-store/legacy/preferences#enable-or-disable-recaptcha-v3-for-contact-forms]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/shopify-payments-now-supports-more-payment-methods; date: July 14, 2020; title: Shopify Payments now supports more payment methods; areas: [Payments]; text: Shopify Payments in Germany, Austria, Sweden, Denmark, Italy, Spain, and the Netherlands now include local payment methods iDEAL and Bancontact; popular in the Netherlands and Belgium. With local payment methods through Shopify Payments, you can maximize conversion by offering customers their preferred option during checkout. Even more, we dynamically position relevant local payment options most likely to improve conversion. For example, buyers from the Netherlands will see iDEAL at the top of the payment options, rather than having to look for it further down the checkout page. Merchants can take advantage of these payment methods confirming they are enabed by navigating to Payment Settings in our Admin Settings page. Learn more about local payment methods from the Shopify Help Centre.; links: [text: local payment methods; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments/local-payment-methods]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/shipping-tax-options-for-us-states; date: July 09, 2020; title: ? Shipping Tax Options for US States; areas: [Admin]; text: ?? New options for shipping taxes will let merchants selling in California, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Louisiana, Maine, or Maryland choose whether or not to tax shipping. We've added this because you've let us know you need more flexibility on whether or not you charge taxes on your shipping, based on your business. The default option will be automatic, which means Shopify will intelligently choose whether or not to tax your shipping based on your shop settings. The new "on" or "off" functions will allow you more fine-grained control over your tax settings. Learn more about shipping tax options from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: shipping tax options; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/taxes/us/us-tax-setup]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/sms-support-in-shopify-chat; date: June 29, 2020; title: SMS Support in Shopify Chat; areas: [Apps]; text: Today we released SMS support in Shopify Chat. If you're using Shopify Chat for live chat on your online store, then customers now have the option to receive a response through SMS instead of waiting for a response in the chat. This way, you can respond to a question even after the customer has left your online store. SMS support is available for use with customer phone numbers in the United States and Canada. There is no cost to sellers, but messaging and data rates might apply for the customer receiving the SMS message. Learn more about SMS support in Shopify Chat from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: SMS support in Shopify Chat; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/ping/shopify-chat#sms-messaging-using-shopify-chat]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/product-performance-insights-on-the-product-page; date: June 29, 2020; title: Product performance insights on the product page; areas: [Products]; text: We've made it easier to gain insight into your products' performance. You can now understand how an individual product has been selling over time, what type of customers are buying it, and where traffic is coming from - directly from the product detail page! Learn more about Product analytics from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Product analytics; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/reports-and-analytics/shopify-reports/report-types/product-analytics]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/changes-to-instagram-feed-in-theme-editor; date: June 29, 2020; title: Changes to Instagram feed in Theme Editor; areas: [Themes]; text: Because Instagram has discontinued its legacy API, if you entered an Instagram access token to the Instagram feed section in the Theme Editor, then the Instagram feed no longer displays images. You can use a third party app to add an Instagram feed to your online store. We recommend that you remove the Instagram feed from the Theme Editor to prevent display issues in your online store. This doesn't impact sales channels like the Instagram channel. Instagram feeds installed by third party apps might not be impacted. Learn how to remove the Instagram feed from the Theme Editor from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: use a third party app to add an Instagram feed; href: https://apps.shopify.com/collections/works-with-instagram | text: remove the Instagram feed from the Theme Editor; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/online-store/legacy/using-themes/change-the-layout/instagram-feed-changes#how-to-remove-the-instagram-section]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/integrate-your-identity-provider-with-shopify-in-the-plus-admin; date: June 25, 2020; title: Integrate your identity provider with Shopify in the Plus admin; areas: [Plus]; text: You can now integrate existing identity providers, enforcing secure authentication on Shopify for users across your entire business. First-party integrations are available for Okta and Azure Active Directory. This is exclusive to Shopify Plus merchants. Learn more about SAML integrations in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Okta; href: https://www.okta.com/integrations/shopify-plus | text: Azure Active Directory; href: https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/en-us/marketplace/apps/aad.shopifyplus | text: SAML integrations; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/saml]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/create-or-edit-customers-from-the-gift-card-issue-page; date: June 19, 2020; title: Create or edit customers from the gift card issue page; areas: [Products]; text: We've just released the ability to create or edit customers from the gift card issue page for all merchants. This will help you save time by creating customers and gift cards in the same place. For example, if your customer says that they accidentally gave you the wrong email address, then you can easily edit the customer's address and resend the gift card. Learn more about creating or editing customers from the gift card issue page from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: creating or editing customers from the gift card issue page; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/gift-card-products/issue-gift-card]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/the-google-shopping-app-is-now-the-google-channel; date: June 15, 2020; title: The Google Shopping app is now the Google channel; areas: [Channels]; text: The Google Shopping app has a new name and a new home base, but the same great features! Find the Google channel in the Sales channels menu of your Shopify admin. Learn more about Shopify's Google channel from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Google channel; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/promoting-marketing/create-marketing/google]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/early-access-for-shopify-ping-on-android; date: June 10, 2020; title: Early access for Shopify Ping on Android ?; areas: [Products]; text: We've released the Android version of Shopify Ping. Ping is a free messaging app that lets merchants chat to customers in real time as they shop. Previously only available on iOS, with this release we have made Ping available to all of Shopify's eligible merchants. Shopify Ping works with Shopify Chat, Apple Business Chat, and Facebook Messenger. You can save time by managing all of your communications and customer service in one place. This gives your customers a better buying experience and makes it easier for you to make sales and build strong customer relationships. Learn more about Shopify Ping from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Ping; href: https://www.shopify.com/ping | text: Shopify Ping; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/promoting-marketing/ping]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/introducing-storefront-signage-maker; date: June 10, 2020; title: Introducing Storefront Signage Maker; areas: [Apps]; text: Let your customers know where they can shop online with a retail storefront sign. The storefront signage maker is an easy way to share with your customers that you are open, available for curbside pickup, delivery, online and more. Choose from a variety of templates and customize it with a personal message. Create a sign for your storefront today.; links: [text: Create a sign; href: https://www.shopify.com/tools/signage-maker]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/improvements-to-shipping-pages; date: June 08, 2020; title: Improvements to shipping pages; areas: [Shipping]; text: We've made it easier to use the Shipping profiles page in the Shopify admin with the following updates: * View your rates separately from carrier and app rates in the rate display table. * Sort the shipping profile list by carrier name and rate name. * Load more items on the page so that you can view them all at once. We've also changed the name of the shipping settings page to Shipping and delivery to reflect additional order delivery methods, including Local delivery. Learn more about Shipping profiles from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shipping profiles; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shipping/setting-up-and-managing-your-shipping/shipping-profiles]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/the-new-shopify-plus-admin; date: June 08, 2020; title: The new Shopify Plus admin; areas: [Plus]; text: The new Shopify Plus admin will be released in phases over the next month to all Shopify Plus merchants. The new admin includes four new features, and an improved navigation for your entire organization. Please note these features are only available to users with Organization access. Overview Ensure your business is running as expected. View and compare your live performance of key business metrics across multiple time periods for all stores in your organization. User Management. Trust the right users with the right tasks. Manage staff across all stores in your organization from one central location. Store Creation. Turn an idea into a new store in 10 seconds. Experiment with new strategies and development environments by creating new stores and copying existing users and pre-installed first party apps from current stores. Organization-level Flow. Save time and effort by automating repetitive tasks in your business. Build and manage Shopify Flow workflows from one central location and then share them with any store in your organization.; links: [text: Organization access; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/users#organization-access | text: View and compare your live performance; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shopify-plus/overview | text: Manage staff across all stores in your organization; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/users#organization-access | text: creating new stores; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/stores | text: Build and manage Shopify Flow workflows; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/flow#organization-level-flow]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/light-mode-for-shopify-pos; date: June 05, 2020; title: Light mode for Shopify POS; areas: [POS]; text: You can now switch to the Shopify POS display mode that best suits the environment you sell in. Go to Settings to choose light mode or dark mode, or just match to your device’s display settings. Learn more about Shopify POS from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify POS; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/shopify-pos]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/tag-workflows-in-shopify-flow; date: June 01, 2020; title: Tag workflows in Shopify Flow; areas: [Plus]; text: You can now add tags to workflows in Shopify Flow from the workflow summary page. Use tags to organize workflows and improve the filtering of the workflows list. Learn more about Shopify Flow from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Flow; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/flow]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/shopify-mobile-ios-9-support-deprecation; date: June 01, 2020; title: Shopify Mobile iOS 9 support deprecation; areas: [Mobile]; text: As of today, software updates for Shopify Mobile, including new features and bug fixes, will be available only on Apple devices using iOS version 10 or higher. We want to ensure that you have the best experience using Shopify Mobile including app reliability and access to new features. If possible, update your device to iOS 10 or greater. Learn how to update your device from Apple support.; links: [text: update your device; href: https://support.apple.com/en-ca/HT204204]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/two-new-operators-in-shopify-flow; date: May 28, 2020; title: Two new operators in Shopify Flow; areas: [Plus]; text: Two new operators are available for string-based conditions in Shopify Flow: is any of is not any of If the field that you want to create a condition on is a string, such as order.billingAddress.firstName, then you can check if it's equal (or not equal) to a comma-separated list of strings. For example: If you create a condition such as order.billingAddress.firstName is any of "Bob,Michal,mary", the condition branch would go to yes if the order's billing address first name was either Bob, Michal or Mary (case insensitive). Similarily, is not any of is the negation of is any of. For the example above but using the is not any of operator, if the order's billing address first name was Victoria, then the yes branch would execute. Learn more about Shopify Flow from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Flow; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/shopify-plus/flow/]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/local-delivery-is-now-available; date: May 25, 2020; title: Local delivery is now available; areas: [Shipping]; text: You can now set up an option for local customers to have their orders delivered. You can choose to have you or your staff deliver orders, or use a third-party delivery service. You can offer delivery within a set distance from your location, or for certain postal codes. Local deliveries can be fulfilled in the Shopify Admin, using the Shopify POS, and on the Shopify mobile app. Local delivery is compatible with Shop Pay. Learn more about local delivery in the Shopify Help Center: Setting up local delivery for online orders Migrating your local delivery method Fulfilling local delivery orders; links: [text: Setting up local delivery for online orders; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shipping/setting-up-and-managing-your-shipping/local-methods/local-delivery | text: Migrating your local delivery method; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shipping/setting-up-and-managing-your-shipping/local-methods/migrate-local-method | text: Fulfilling local delivery orders; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/orders/fulfillment/fulfilling-orders/fulfill-local-delivery]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/introducing-express-a-theme-built-for-your-food-and-beverage-business; date: May 21, 2020; title: Introducing Express, a theme built for your food and beverage business; areas: [Online Store]; text: Express is a free, fast theme that lets businesses take orders online while keeping control of their customers, profits, and brand. Express includes the following features: A home page layout perfect for one-page stores with minimal content. A menu-inspired design that lets customers focus on ordering, rather than product discovery. A collapsible cart drawer and product modals that make it easy for your customers to build an order. Express is available in the theme store. Learn more about Express in the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Express is available in the theme store.; href: https://themes.shopify.com/themes/express/styles/bistro | text: Express; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/using-themes/themes-by-shopify/express]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/introducing-tipping-options-for-online-orders; date: May 20, 2020; title: Introducing tipping options for online orders; areas: [Checkout]; text: Tipping can now be enabled for your online checkout in one click. When tipping is enabled, your customer can choose the option to tip based on a percentage of their total order or a custom amount. Previously only available through Shopify POS, tipping options for online orders make it easy for customers to show their support for the stores they love. Learn more about online tipping from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: online tipping; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/checkout-settings/tips]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/tap-chip-reader-with-interac-flash-now-available-in-canada; date: May 12, 2020; title: Tap & Chip Reader with Interac Flash now available in Canada; areas: [Channels]; text: The Tap & Chip Reader is now available to Canadian sellers! The Retail Kit and Tap & Chip Case are also available. The Tap & Chip Reader accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Google Pay, Apple Pay, and for the first time ever - contactless Interac Flash transactions. Transaction fees apply. With the Tap & Chip Reader and Retail Kit, Canadian sellers can use the all-new Shopify POS, integrated payments, and award-winning hardware. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/offset-your-store-s-shipping-emissions-with-offset-by-shopify; date: April 23, 2020; title: Offset your store's shipping emissions with Offset (by Shopify)!; areas: [Shipping]; text: We released Offset (by Shopify) in the Shopify App Store on Earth Day, April 22, for all Shopify stores. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/simple-clear-and-accurate-us-sales-tax-setup; date: April 06, 2020; title: Simple, clear, and accurate US sales tax setup; areas: [Admin]; text: Collecting sales taxes in the United States ?? has gotten easier. Tell Shopify where you’re registered for sales taxes, and Shopify automatically determines the tax to collect on orders. The following details apply to this update: - Rounding on orders is now at the line level. - Adding a location no longer automatically turns on tax collection for the state where the location is located. - Tax overrides are applicable at a state level only, allowing you to easily exempt products that shouldn’t be taxed. - Add registrations for states where you don’t have a location but where you have an economic nexus. - Select between destination and hybrid origin sales tax in California. This feature is available to most merchants selling within the United States. Learn more about US Tax Registrations from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: US Tax Registrations; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/taxes/us/us-tax-migrate]

Learn more about selling in multiple currencies from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: selling in multiple currencies; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments/multi-currency/]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/you-can-no-longer-use-facebook-messenger-with-kit; date: March 04, 2020; title: You can no longer use Facebook Messenger with Kit; areas: [Apps]; text: Due to new limitations imposed by Facebook, Kit can no longer start a conversation with you through Facebook Messenger. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/shopify-pay-is-now-shop-pay; date: February 13, 2020; title: Shopify Pay is now Shop Pay; areas: [Checkout]; text: Shopify Pay, an accelerated checkout that lets customers save their shipping and billing information so that they can check out faster from Shopify stores, now has a new name: Shop Pay. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/order-editing-is-now-available-for-plus-stores; date: February 11, 2020; title: Order editing is now available for Plus stores; areas: [Plus]; text: Order editing enables you to make changes to existing orders within Shopify. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/check-your-store-s-status-on-the-updated-shopify-status-page; date: February 11, 2020; title: Check your store’s status on the updated Shopify status page; areas: [Admin]; text: With over a million stores on Shopify, it’s rare that an incident impacts everyone. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/edit-existing-orders-in-shopify; date: November 08, 2019; title: Edit existing orders in Shopify; areas: [Orders]; text: With order editing, you can now make changes to an order without using workarounds, saving you time and effort. Fulfill customer requests more easily, even after an order has been paid. Have more control over order details by using the following features: Add new items or custom items to an order. Remove existing items from an order and restock them to your store's inventory. Adjust the quantity of an item in an order. Send invoices to customers when the order total increases. Send order change notifications to customers. View accurate reporting about orders with changes. Choose the staff members who can edit orders by using staff permissions. This feature is not yet available for all stores. Learn more about order editing from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: order editing; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/orders/edit-orders]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/marketing-automations-in-shopify; date: November 08, 2019; title: Marketing automations in Shopify; areas: [Marketing]; text: Organize, manage and measure your marketing efforts more easily in Shopify with new sections in Shopify Marketing: Overview - View a summary of all your marketing efforts and performance metrics. Campaigns -Create a marketing campaign, and group marketing activities together to work toward a specific objective. Campaigns are published within a set timeframe, so they're best for specific goals or events, for example advertising for a promotion or a season. Automations - Create marketing automations including Google Smart Shopping Campaigns. Automations are best for building a customer base and improving online store traffic on an ongoing basis. You can use automations to capture new store visitors, improve online store conversions, and market to existing store visitors. As a part of this update, you can now measure the performance of Shopify's abandoned checkout service from the Automations page. The report contains attributed sessions and sales metrics. Learn more about Marketing in Shopify from the Shopify Help Center, or install apps that work with Shopify Marketing from the Shopify App store.; links: [text: Marketing in Shopify; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/promoting-marketing/create-marketing/create-marketing-campaigns | text: apps that work with Shopify Marketing; href: https://apps.shopify.com/collections/works-with-shopify-marketing]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/add-product-or-location-specific-shipping-rates-with-shipping-profiles; date: November 04, 2019; title: Add product or location specific shipping rates with shipping profiles; areas: [Shipping]; text: Introducing shipping profiles, a new way to customize shipping settings for specific products and locations. Assign different rates depending on what you sell, where you ship from, and your customer’s location to optimize your checkout experience. Some uses for shipping profiles could include: You sell fragile or bulky items and want to cover the cost of extra packaging, handling, or insurance. You ship from multiple locations and want to ship from the one that’s closest to your customer. You work with multiple vendors and want to charge different rates based on where the product is shipping from. You ship some products with specific mail classes (for example, you sell books using USPS media mail). Learn more about shipping profiles from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: shipping profiles; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shipping/setting-up-and-managing-your-shipping/shipping-profiles]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/get-insights-about-your-online-store-traffic-from-the-marketing-page-in-shopify; date: October 30, 2019; title: Get insights about your online store traffic from the Marketing page in Shopify; areas: [Marketing]; text: You can now see insights about your online store traffic from the Marketing page in Shopify, so you can make more informed marketing decisions! Which online sources bring traffic that converts to sales at the highest rates? To access these insights, tap on Online store sessions on the Marketing page. To see more detailed information, click View report in the traffic insights. Learn more about Measuring marketing performance from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Measuring marketing performance; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/promoting-marketing/analyze-marketing/marketing-performance]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/new-customizations-introduced-to-storefront-search; date: October 23, 2019; title: New customizations introduced to storefront search; areas: [Online Store]; text: You can set up your store search to work with words that don't have a complete ending. To set this up, you add a prefix on the last term to enable partial word matches with the prefix parameter. This is only available to merchants who have their store’s locale set to English. These customizations can be done through liquid and tutorials are available for reference in our Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Help Center; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-online/online-store/storefront-search]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/updates-to-the-buy-button-channel; date: October 16, 2019; title: Updates to the Buy Button channel; areas: [Channels]; text: To better help you create Buy Buttons and checkout links for your website or blog, we've made the following updates the the Buy Button channel: It's easier to customize your Buy Buttons - we reorganized the appearance of your settings based on user feedback. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/new-customer-tag-limit; date: September 23, 2019; title: New customer tag limit; areas: [Customers]; text: In your Shopify admin, a saved customer now has a limit of 250 tags on the details page. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/retry-failed-bill-payments-manually-from-shopify; date: September 11, 2019; title: Retry failed bill payments manually from Shopify; areas: [Admin]; text: If your bill payment fails, then you no longer need to wait for Shopify to automatically retry the payment. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/customers-can-send-you-images-through-apple-business-chat; date: September 03, 2019; title: Customers can send you images through Apple Business Chat ?️; areas: [Channels]; text: When you have Apple Business Chat enabled on your store, customers can now send you images through Messages. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/customer-tax-exemptions-for-canada; date: September 03, 2019; title: Customer tax exemptions for Canada ??; areas: [Checkout]; text: Sometimes, customers don't have to pay sales taxes. Tax exemption options are available for stores that use the new Canadian taxes feature and sell to customers in Canada. Learn more about customer tax exemptions for Canada from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: new Canadian taxes feature; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/taxes/canada/canada-tax-migrate | text: customer tax exemptions for Canada; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/taxes/canada/canada-tax-exemptions]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/pay-your-shopify-bill-with-paypal; date: August 26, 2019; title: Pay your Shopify bill with PayPal!; areas: [Admin]; text: Good news - when it's time to pay your Shopify bill, use a payment method you know and trust by paying with PayPal. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/improvements-to-express-checkout-on-cart; date: August 22, 2019; title: Improvements to express checkout on cart; areas: [Checkout]; text: Your customers can enjoy a more seamless express checkout experience from your store's cart page. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/typo-tolerance-in-storefront-search; date: August 14, 2019; title: Typo tolerance in storefront search ⌨️; areas: [Online Store]; text: We’re making sure your customers can find the products they’re searching for, even if their search has typos! uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/announcing-shopify-chat; date: August 14, 2019; title: Announcing Shopify Chat ?; areas: [Marketing]; text: Connect with your customers and help them find products they'll love. Shopify Chat is available to all online store visitors. Customers browsing your store can click a button to start a chat with you in the browser window. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/multi-currency-available-for-all-stores-using-shopify-payments; date: August 12, 2019; title: Multi-currency available for all stores using Shopify Payments; areas: [Payments]; text: Let your customers shop in their local currency, and they will be more likely to place an order. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/new-payment-error-notification-for-customers; date: May 17, 2019; title: New payment error notification for customers; areas: [Checkout]; text: We’re always looking for ways to improve the checkout experience for your customers, even when something’s going wrong. That's why we built a new customizable email notification to let your customers know when a payment has failed due to an error outside of their control. Beginning May 31st, when a payment fails due to a connection issue with a customer's bank or your payment provider, the customer receives an email notifying them of the error and confirming they haven’t been charged. This email will contain a link to their cart, and a link back to your store. Emails are highly effective in recapturing lost traffic, and we want to make sure that if anything goes wrong, your customers are the first to know. The template is available now, so you have two weeks to customize the notifications before the emails are enabled. We recommend that you upgrade to a device that supports iOS 10 or above and a supported card reader from the Shopify Hardware Store. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/create-facebook-dynamic-ads-in-shopify; date: March 28, 2019; title: Create Facebook Dynamic Ads in Shopify; areas: [Marketing]; text: Retarget your store’s visitors by promoting relevant products through Facebook dynamic ads, which you can now create from your Shopify admin. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/easily-switch-between-multiple-stores; date: March 19, 2019; title: Easily switch between multiple stores ?; areas: [Admin]; text: We’ve just released a simpler way for you to navigate between your Shopify stores.
