uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/manually-sort-your-products-in-a-collection; date: March 14, 2019; title: Manually sort your products in a collection; areas: [Products]; text: Click and drag products in your collections so they appear in any order that you want! uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/changes-to-credit-and-debit-card-fields-in-checkout; date: March 13, 2019; title: Changes to credit and debit card fields in checkout; areas: [Checkout]; text: In order to provide greater clarity and ease of use to your customers during checkout, Shopify's checkout team has made some changes to the credit card and debit card input fields! Cardholder name is becoming Name on card CVV is becoming Security code MM / YY is becoming Expiry date (MM / YY) For a more consistent customer experience, the name of input fields related to expiry and issue dates of cards are now standardized to Expiry Date (MM/YY) and Issue Date (MM/YY). If you use one of your theme’s supported languages, then you don't need to do anything. We'll update the translation automatically. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/receipt-printing-for-android-pos; date: March 12, 2019; title: Receipt printing for Android POS; areas: [POS]; text: We're excited to share that our team has been hard at work to bring receipt printing to the Shopify POS app for Android. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/pos-receipt-numbers-on-the-order-details-page; date: March 04, 2019; title: POS receipt numbers on the Order details page; areas: [Orders]; text: Now you can find POS receipt numbers from an order's details page in both web and mobile. By using receipt numbers instead of order numbers for customer receipts, Shopify has made notable improvements to the speed of POS checkouts. When your in-person customers can check out faster, it's good for everyone! You can find the receipt number in the header area of each POS order from your Shopify admin and from the Shopify Mobile app.

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/products-now-have-a-limit-of-250-tags; date: March 04, 2019; title: Products now have a limit of 250 tags; areas: [Products]; text: To speed up performance, products can no longer have more than 250 tags (whether they're created automatically by an app or created manually in the Shopify admin). Any products that already have more than 250 tags will keep their existing tags, but they can't have more tags added to them unless enough of their existing tags are deleted to bring them under the new limit. This limit currently applies to stores on the Advanced Shopify plan and below. Learn more about managing product tags from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: managing product tags; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/details/tags]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/add-information-required-to-calculate-custom-duties-on-your-products; date: February 25, 2019; title: Add information required to calculate custom duties on your products; areas: [Products]; text: We're making international selling easier! When shipping products to international buyers, you need to provide a Harmonized System (HS) code and a country of origin for the products. This information is used by customs to calculate duties. We've introduced a new way to look up HS codes from the product details page, so you don't need to visit an external website. You can also specifiy the country of origin from the product details page. When you print international shipping labels by using Shopify Shipping, the HS code and country of origin are automatically added to labels, which saves you from repetitive work. Other shipping apps can also use this information through our API. Learn more about import fees from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: import fees; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/import-fees]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/upcoming-deprecation-google-shopping-app-old-version; date: February 25, 2019; title: Upcoming deprecation: Google Shopping app (old version); areas: [Apps]; text: Shopify has a new version of the Google Shopping app, and the old version is being deprecated and won't be available any more. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/european-union-merchants-need-to-provide-their-vat-number; date: February 13, 2019; title: European Union merchants need to provide their VAT number; areas: [Admin]; text: Merchants in the European Union are being asked to submit or verify their VAT number, or let Shopify know that they don't have a VAT number. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/remove-a-primary-domain-from-shopify-more-quickly; date: February 12, 2019; title: Remove a primary domain from Shopify more quickly; areas: [Online Store]; text: We've made it faster to remove a domain that's set as the primary domain for your Shopify online store. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/personalize-interactions-with-the-new-pos-customers-tab; date: February 05, 2019; title: Personalize interactions with the new POS Customers Tab; areas: [POS]; text: Shopify's new Customers Tab on POS helps you give your shoppers a great experience. The Customers Tab gives you a quick and easy way to access, add, and update customer profiles. You can contact your customers directly from their profile using email, phone, or SMS, or use it to personalize in-store interactions. Open a customer’s profile during checkout to access their entire order history. Then, use their order history to make personalized product recommendations or to quickly process returns and exchanges. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/sell-in-multiple-currencies-with-shopify-payments-on-shopify-plus; date: February 05, 2019; title: Sell in multiple currencies with Shopify Payments on Shopify Plus; areas: [Plus]; text: Sell globally in up to 9 currencies and get paid in your local currency all on a single store! uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/shopify-plus-checkout-upgrade; date: February 04, 2019; title: Shopify Plus checkout upgrade; areas: [Plus]; text: Between February 4th and March 4th, Shopify Plus merchants with customized checkouts will have the opportunity to upgrade to the latest version of Shopify's checkout, getting access to increased stability, better security, and new features. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/0-vat-on-shopify-payments-fees-in-germany-and-spain; date: February 01, 2019; title: 0% VAT on Shopify Payments fees in Germany and Spain; areas: [Payments]; text: Shopify Payments merchants in Germany and Spain will begin seeing 0% VAT on their Shopify Payments fees starting on their February invoice. The fees are subject to the reverse charge. Merchants will need to account for the VAT in their country. The Shopify Payments Terms of Service will be updated to reflect this change. Account owners who are affected by this change will receive a notification from Shopify. Merchants will need to verify their VAT number with Shopify as a part of this change.

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/usps-on-shopify-shipping-now-has-the-lowest-rates-and-more-options; date: January 27, 2019; title: USPS on Shopify Shipping now has the lowest rates and more options; areas: [Shipping]; text: Shopify Shipping offers the lowest USPS shipping rates available anywhere and access to two additional mail classes. Here’s what’s new: Priority Mail Cubic pricing is available to merchants on the Shopify and Advanced plans. Cubic pricing is a deeply discounted rate for shipping small packages weighing up to 20 lbs. Save up to 90% off retail Priority Mail costs. This is a great incentive to offer free expedited shipping to customers. Shopify continues to offer First-Class Package International Service (FCPIS) at 2018 rates instead of 2019 rates. You get up to 21% off retail shipping costs when you ship internationally. These are the lowest FCPIS rate available anywhere. Parcel Select Ground and Media Mail have been added as shipping methods. These are low-cost options for shipping packages that aren’t in a hurry. Include these methods to build a free shipping strategy for your store. Learn more about these updates and see how much it costs to ship with USPS on Shopify using the Shopify Shipping calculator.; links: [text: Learn more about these updates; href: https://www.shopify.com/blog//usps-shipping-2019 | text: Shopify Shipping calculator; href: https://www.shopify.com/toolbox/shipping/calculator]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/it-s-now-easier-to-switch-between-shopify-plus-stores; date: January 24, 2019; title: It’s now easier to switch between Shopify Plus stores ?; areas: [Plus]; text: We’ve just released a simpler way for you to navigate between your Shopify Plus stores. Now, when you log in to your Shopify admin, you will see a new dropdown menu in the upper left corner. This dropdown contains all the Shopify Plus stores where you have an account with the same email address (account name). The stores are grouped in the dropdown by business (based on your Shopify contracts). Clicking on a store name will bring you to that store’s admin. To help make your stores more secure, your email address (as well as those of your staff) should be verified. When your email is verified, then you can switch to your other stores without being prompted for your passwords. If your email is not verified, then you will be asked for your password. Learn more about the dropdown at the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: the dropdown; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/your-account/logging-in/shopify-admin-dropdown]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/let-your-wholesale-customers-mix-and-match-variants-with-volume-pricing-by-product; date: January 22, 2019; title: Let your wholesale customers mix and match variants with volume pricing by product ?️; areas: [Plus]; text: Introducing a new pricing strategy for the Shopify Plus wholesale channel that lets wholesale customers order the products they want! Volume pricing by product allows your wholesale customers to mix and match product variants to meet your store's wholesale pricing requirements. When you set up volume pricing by product, the minimum order quantity, maximum order quantity, and volume is calculated based on the total quantity of all of the variants for each product. You can still choose offer pricing based on the specific quantity of individual variants in an order, too. Learn More about wholesale pricing from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: wholesale pricing; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-online/wholesale/channel/price-lists-customers/reference]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/postmates-integration-removed-from-shopify; date: January 22, 2019; title: Postmates integration removed from Shopify; areas: [Shipping]; text: Recent product features in Shopify caused changes that made Postmates incompatible as a delivery method. We are exploring other options to support on-demand delivery in the future. You can also search the Shopify App Store for available third-party local delivery apps.; links: [text: search the Shopify App Store; href: https://apps.shopify.com/search?q=local+delivery]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/canada-post-for-shopify-app-removed; date: January 22, 2019; title: Canada Post for Shopify app removed; areas: [Shipping]; text: We've removed the Canada Post for Shopify app. If you're located in Canada, you can show Canada Post rates at checkout and buy discounted shipping labels directly from your Shopify admin. There's no need to install an app to do this any more. This doesn't impact stores using Shopify Shipping with Canada Post. Learn more about how to set up calculated rates, and how to buy and print Canada Post labels from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: set up calculated rates; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shipping/rates-and-methods/custom-calculated-rates/setup-custom-calculated-rate | text: buy and print Canada Post labels; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/shipping/shopify-shipping/buy-and-print]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/create-marketing-campaigns-with-a-goal-in-mind; date: January 17, 2019; title: Create marketing campaigns with a goal in mind; areas: [Admin]; text: Now, when you create a marketing campaign in Shopify, you can base your campaign on a goal instead of starting a campaign at the same time as a specific marketing activity. By thinking of a goal or objective before starting a marketing activity, you can more easily plan for and organize the marketing activities that you create on Shopify. Learn more about marketing campaigns from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: marketing campaigns; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/promoting-marketing/create-marketing/create-marketing-campaigns]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/ecommerce-university-forums-have-moved-to-shopify-community; date: January 17, 2019; title: Ecommerce University Forums have moved to Shopify Community; areas: [Customers]; text: Visit Shopify Community to engage in meaningful conversations with other Shopify merchants and partners. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/canadian-sales-taxes-just-got-simpler; date: January 16, 2019; title: Canadian sales taxes just got simpler ??; areas: [Admin]; text: Tax calculation is challenging, and mistakes impact your operations and customers, and can also make you vulnerable to penalties. Now, worry less about your Canadian sales taxes with automated rate updates and registration-based sales tax collection. Automated rate updates Never track sales tax rate changes in Canada again! Shopify will handle this from now on - GST, PST, HST - all automatically updated so you have up to the minute sales tax rates across Canada. Registration-based sales tax collection Not sure where you should be charging taxes? Check out our Canadian Sales Tax Guide. Once you’ve got an idea of where you should be charging taxes, Shopify removes the guesswork. Select the provinces you’re registered in and get going! Learn more about setting up Canadian taxes at the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Canadian Sales Tax Guide; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/taxes/canada/canada-tax-reference | text: Canadian taxes; href: https://help.shopify.com/manual/taxes/canada]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/faster-checkout-for-customers-during-flash-sales; date: November 16, 2018; title: Faster checkout for customers during flash sales; areas: [Admin]; text: During the busiest times of the year, like Black Friday and Cyber Monday, customers can check out faster. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/improved-storefront-search-better-results; date: October 31, 2018; title: Improved storefront search - better results ?; areas: [Online Store]; text: Customers can more easily find what they're looking for using improved storefront search in English and Japanese. uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/new-inventory-csv-file-for-quickly-updating-inventory-quantities; date: September 07, 2018; title: New inventory CSV file for quickly updating inventory quantities; areas: [Products]; text: Update inventory quantities without risking making changes to other product details, using the new CSV export and import tool. Unlike the existing CSV file for products, this CSV is focused exclusively on updating inventory quantities. The benefit of a more focused spreadsheet is that it's faster and easier to update inventory quantites in bulk, without risking overwriting other product information (such as publishing details or product images). This feature is extra useful to support your inventory cycle or annual inventory counts! Learn more about exporting or importing inventory with a CSV file in the Help Center.; links: [text: CSV file for products; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/import-export/import-products | text: exporting or importing inventory with a CSV file; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/products/inventory/inventory-csv]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/all-your-store-policies-in-one-convenient-place; date: September 06, 2018; title: All your store policies in one convenient place; areas: [Admin]; text: You don't have to create custom pages for your store policies any more! ? Add and update your store policies from an easy-to-find, dedicated section, and link to them from your store menus. In the past, you could see your store policies, like your Terms of Service, on your checkout page, and you could update them from the Checkout settings. Now, you can find policies in the Settings > Legal section. Best of all - Add any policy to any menu in your online store, to make it easier to keep them up to date. One source of truth! You won't have to worry about forgetting to update these legal documents in two different places. Learn more about store policies from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: store policies; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-online/checkout-settings/refund-privacy-tos]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/shopify-pay-is-even-faster-for-returning-customers; date: September 05, 2018; title: Shopify Pay is even faster for returning customers ?; areas: [Payments]; text: When a customer who uses Shopify Pay returns to your store within 30 days, they can check out faster than ever. Customers returning to the same store can now use Shopify Pay without an SMS validation. This will work for customers using the same device and browser within 30 days of their last order. Instead, customers will be redirected to the new pay.shopify.com landing page to confirm their details. This is another big step to reducing friction on the checkout! Learn more about the Shopify Pay customer experience at the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: Shopify Pay customer experience; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-pay#customer-experience]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/introducing-the-redesigned-shopify-app-store; date: September 05, 2018; title: Introducing the redesigned Shopify App Store; areas: [Apps]; text: We've beautifully redesigned the Shopify App Store from ground up to help you find the right app for your unique business. Choose the best app for your business with streamlined listings, clear app information, and a simplified pricing structure. Search is now more accurate than ever, with relevant information available right on the search results page. Finally, app recommendations are smarter than ever and tailored to you. Learn more about the new Shopify App Store and visit it today.; links: [text: Shopify App Store; href: https://www.shopify.ca/blog/new-shopify-app-store | text: visit it today; href: https://apps.shopify.com]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/tipping-on-shopify-pos; date: September 04, 2018; title: Tipping on Shopify POS; areas: [POS]; text: Give your customers the chance to leave a tip! Add tipping to the checkout for in-person orders processed with the credit payment method. Your customers can have the opportunity to share their appreciation for great service in your store. Learn more about collecting, tracking and refunding Shopify POS Tips.; links: [text: Learn more; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-in-person/transactions/tips]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/sell-in-your-preferred-currency-and-get-paid-in-your-local-currency; date: August 21, 2018; title: Sell in your preferred currency and get paid in your local currency; areas: [Payments]; text: Good news! With Shopify Payments, now you can sell in a preferred currency and get paid in your local currency. This means you can sell to customers who are in a different country than the country where your business is located, without needing to set up a separate bank account for that currency. Selling and getting paid in different currencies is available to stores in Australia, Canada, Hong Kong, Ireland, Japan, New Zealand, Singapore, Germany, and the United Kingdom. Learn more about selling and getting paid in different currencies from the Shopify Help Center.; links: [text: selling and getting paid in different currencies; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/payments/shopify-payments/selling-and-getting-paid-in-different-currencies]

uri: https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/include-more-of-your-product-images-with-the-updated-buy-button-template; date: August 13, 2018; title: Include more of your product images with the updated Buy Button template!; areas: [Channels]; text: Share more of your beautiful product photos with customers in the same Buy Button template! ? We’ve made an update to the first Buy Button template (product image, price, and button) so you can include all of your product images, instead of just variant images. In addition, we’ve updated the Change product and Full width preview buttons in the Buy Button sales channel to make them more visible. You might not spot the difference at first glance, but we wanted to mention it anyway. ? Visit the Shopify Help Center to learn more about Buy Button.; links: [text: Buy Button; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/sell-online/buy-button]

list: accordionItems; heading: هل توجد تكاليف مبدئية للبيع دوليًا مع Shopify؟; content: التكلفة المسبقة الوحيدة للوصول بمتجرك إلى العالمية هي تكلفة خطة Shopify الشهرية. أما رسوم Shopify Managed Markets أو بعض الميزات المدفوعة في الأدوات الدولية الأخرى، فتُفرض على كل معاملة عند إتمام مبيعات دولية. كما أنك غير مُلزم بأي فترات تعاقدية، مما يتيح لك تجربة الميزات دون أي التزامات.

list: accordionItems; heading: كيف تُفرض رسوم Shopify Managed Markets على المشترين؟; content:

بشكل افتراضي، تُدمج جميع الرسوم المرتبطة بـ Shopify Managed Markets — بما في ذلك رسوم المنتجات، والضرائب، ورسوم تحويل العملات — في الأسعار التي يراها المشترون الدوليون في صفحة الدفع. يدفع المشترون سعرًا محليًا واحدًا وشاملاً، بينما تدفع أنت رسوم معالجة Shopify Payments القياسية على كل معاملة.

على عكس معظم أدوات البيع الدولية التي تُخصم فيها الرسوم من عوائدك، فإن Managed Markets لا يخفض إيراداتك المحلية بفرض رسوم عبر الحدود.

ملاحظة: إذا كنت تستخدم تسعيرًا دوليًا ثابتًا، فقد تختلف طريقة تطبيق الرسوم.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-0; heading: ما هي منصة Shopify وكيف تعمل؟; content: Shopify هي منصة تجارة متكاملة تتيح لك إنشاء متجر إلكتروني، وقبول المدفوعات، والبيع عبر القنوات الاجتماعية وفي المتاجر الفعلية؛ كل ذلك من لوحة تحكم واحدة. يمكنك بناء واجهة متجر احترافية، وإدارة المنتجات والمخزون، ومعالجة الطلبات والشحن، وأتمتة التسويق وتحسين محركات البحث، وتحليل المبيعات، وإدارة عملك من الويب أو الهاتف المحمول—دون الحاجة إلى أي خبرة في البرمجة.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-1; heading: ما هي تكلفة الاشتراك في Shopify؟; content: تبدأ تجربة Shopify بفترة مجانية لمدة 3 من الأيام—دون الحاجة لبطاقة ائتمان. بعد انتهاء الفترة التجريبية، تبدأ أسعار معظم الباقات من ‏1 US$ فقط شهريًا لأول 3 من الأشهر، ثم تنتقل إلى التسعير الشهري القياسي.

بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يمكنك اختيار إضافة باقة POS Pro إلى اشتراكك للاستمتاع بميزات نقاط بيع متقدمة مثل أدوار وصلاحيات الموظفين، وعمليات الاستبدال، وخيارات مرنة للاستلام من المتجر والتوصيل للعملاء.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-2; heading: هل يمكنني إلغاء أو تغيير اشتراكي في أي وقت؟; content: نعم. إذا قررت في أي وقت أن منصة Shopify ليست منصة التجارة الأنسب لعملك، يمكنك بكل بساطة إلغاء حسابك.

أما إذا اخترت اشتراك باقة Plus السنوي أو لمدة 3 سنوات، فيمكنك الإلغاء عند انتهاء فترة التزامك.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-3; heading: هل هناك أي رسوم إضافية؟; content: لا توجد رسوم إعداد لأي من باقاتنا.

قد تُطبق رسوم معاملات خارجية عند استخدام موفر خدمة دفع خارجي (بدلاً من Shopify Payments). وتعتمد النسبة على باقتك.

تفرض Shopify رسومًا رمزية للسماح لك بقبول بطاقات الائتمان الرئيسية، مثل Visa وMastercard، كوسيلة دفع في متجرك. وتختلف هذه الرسوم حسب الباقة التي تختارها.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-4; heading: ما هي الدول التي يمكنني استخدام Shopify فيها؟; content: تتوفر منصة Shopify في جميع دول العالم تقريبًا. وتختلف بعض الميزات حسب الدولة—على سبيل المثال، لا تتوفر خدمة Shopify Payments إلا في دول معينة—لذا قد تختلف خيارات الدفع والتسعير بناءً على مقر عملك.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-5; heading: هل منصة Shopify متوافقة مع معايير PCI أم معتمدة من PCI؟; content: نعم. منصة Shopify معتمدة لتتوافق مع معايير PCI DSS من المستوى الأول، والمتاجر التي تعمل بمنصة Shopify تتوافق مع معايير PCI افتراضيًا، مما يساعد في الحفاظ على أمان معلومات الدفع.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-6; heading: هل يمكنني استخدام اسم النطاق الخاص بي مع Shopify؟; content: نعم. يمكنك استخدام نطاق تملكه بالفعل، أو شراء نطاق جديد. يأتي كل متجر على Shopify أيضًا مع عنوان myshopify.com مجاني، وتساعدك Shopify في الحفاظ على أمان موقعك تلقائيًا.

إذا كان لديك نطاق بالفعل، فيمكنك الاحتفاظ به لدى الجهة التي اشتريته منها وربطه ببساطة بمنصة Shopify—أو نقله إلى Shopify لإدارة كل شيء من مكان واحد.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-7; heading: هل أحصل على استضافة ويب مع Shopify؟; content: نعم. تتضمن باقة Shopify استضافة تجارية آمنة، لذا لست بحاجة إلى شراء استضافة منفصلة. توفر Shopify أيضًا نطاقًا تردديًا غير محدود (بدون رسوم نطاق ترددي) وتقدم شهادة TLS/SSL مجانية للنطاقات التي تضيفها إلى Shopify.

بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يمكنك استخدام قناة مبيعات Buy Button لتضمين أزرار الشراء في موقع ويب خارجي أو مدونة، والسماح للعملاء بإتمام الدفع باستخدام Shopify Checkout.

list: apyDisclaimer; heading: تطبيق Shopify Bill Pay مقدم من ; description: إن Shopify شركة تكنولوجيا، وليست بنكًا. نحن نتعاون مع Stripe Payments Company لتقديم خدمات تحويل الأموال وخدمات الحسابات، مع الاحتفاظ بالأموال لدى Fifth Third Bank N.A.، وهو عضو في المؤسسة الفيدرالية لتأمين الودائع (FDIC). تُدعم بطاقات Shopify Balance Visa® التجارية بواسطة Stripe وتُصدر من قِبل Celtic Bank بموجب ترخيص من شركة Visa U.S.A. list: list; text: يُعد معدل أرباح Balance بمثابة مكافأة مقدمة من Shopify وليس فائدة. هذا المعدل متغير، ويخضع للتغيير دون إشعار مسبق، وهو دقيق اعتبارًا من 29 أكتوبر 2026. تتراكم المكافأة يوميًا وتُدفع شهريًا في شكل رصيد يُضاف إلى حساب Balance الخاص بك. قد تُطبق حدود ACH. راجع شروط المكافآت. تُكافأ المتاجر المشتركة في خطة Shopify Plus بنسبة 3.54‎%‎، بينما تحصل جميع الخطط الأخرى على نسبة 2.52‎%‎.

list: list; text: يشير "الاسترداد النقدي" إلى المكافآت المُكتسبة كنسبة خصم على المشتريات المؤهلة. احصل على استرداد نقدي بنسبة 3% يُضاف كرصيد إلى كشف الحساب على ما يصل إلى 250,000 دولار أمريكي من المشتريات السنوية المؤهلة ضمن فئة الإنفاق الشهري الأعلى لديك—سواء كانت في التسويق، أو معالجة الطلبات، أو البيع بالجملة، واسترداد نقدي بنسبة 1% لما يتجاوز ذلك. واحصل على استرداد نقدي بنسبة 1% على فئتي الإنفاق الأخريين. تُطبق بعض القيود. راجع شروط البرنامج لمعرفة التفاصيل. افتراضيًا، يتم إدراجك لدفع رصيد كشف حسابك بالكامل عبر خصم تلقائي من حسابك البنكي المخصص خلال شهر واحد لتجنب الرسوم. ويمكنك التبديل إلى سداد مدفوعات يومية من مبيعاتك للحصول على مهلة تصل إلى 10 أشهر لسداد رصيد كشف الحساب بالكامل، مقابل رسوم. وإذا لم يتم استلام الدفعة بالكامل خلال 10 أشهر، ستُطبق رسوم تأخير شهرية بنسبة 2% على رصيدك المتأخر المستحق.

list: questions; question: ما هي تكلفة Shopify POS؟; answer:

التكلفة الإجمالية لـ Shopify POS هي مزيج من باقتك، ورسوم المعاملات، ومواقع POS Pro.

باقتك هي الأساس لحسابك. فهي تمنحك إمكانية الوصول إلى نقطة البيع، والمبيعات عبر الإنترنت، ومعالجة المدفوعات، والتسويق، والتحليلات، وأدوات الشحن، والمزيد.

رسوم معاملاتك هي نسبة مئوية تُخصم تلقائيًا من كل عملية بيع تتم من خلال Shopify. تعتمد رسوم المعاملات على الباقة التي تختارها.

list: accordionItems; heading: Are there upfront costs to sell internationally with Shopify?; content: The only upfront cost to take your store global is the cost of your monthly Shopify plan. Fees for Shopify Managed Markets or select paid features with other international tools are billed on a per-transaction basis as you make international sales. You're also not locked into any contract periods so that you can try features without commitment.

list: accordionItems; heading: How are Shopify Managed Markets fees charged to my buyers?; content:

By default, all fees associated with Shopify Managed Markets, including product fees, taxes, and currency conversion fees, are built into the prices your international buyers see at checkout. Buyers pay a single all-inclusive local price, and you pay your standard Shopify Payments processing fee on each transaction.

Unlike most international selling tools, where fees are deducted from your payout, Managed Markets doesn’t reduce your domestic revenue with cross-border fees.

Note: If you use fixed international pricing, the way fees are applied may vary.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-0; heading: What is Shopify and how does it work?; content: Shopify is an all-in-one commerce platform that lets you create an online store, accept payments, and sell on social channels and in person—all from one dashboard. Build a professional storefront, manage products and inventory, process orders and shipping, automate marketing and SEO, analyze sales, and run your business from web or mobile—no coding required.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-1; heading: How much does Shopify cost?; content: Shopify starts with a free 3-day trial—no credit card required. After your trial, most plans start at just $1 per month for the first 3 months, then switch to standard monthly pricing.

Additionally, you can choose to add POS Pro to your subscription for more advanced point of sale features like staff roles and permissions, exchanges, and flexible customer pickup and delivery options.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-2; heading: Can I cancel or change my subscription anytime?; content: Yes. If you ever decide that Shopify isn't the best commerce platform for your business, simply cancel your account.

If you choose a 1- or 3-year Plus subscription, you can cancel when your term commitment expires.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-3; heading: Are there any additional fees?; content: There are no setup fees on any of our plans.

Third-party transaction fees may apply when you use a third-party payment provider (instead of Shopify Payments). The rate depends on your plan.

Shopify charges a small fee to allow you to accept major credit cards, such as Visa and Mastercard, as payment in your store. These fees vary depending on the plan that you choose.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-4; heading: In what countries can I use Shopify?; content: Shopify is available in nearly every country in the world. Some features vary by country—for example, Shopify Payments is available only in certain countries—so pricing and payment options can differ depending on where your business is based.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-5; heading: Is Shopify PCI Compliant or PCI Certified?; content: Yes. Shopify is certified Level 1 PCI DSS compliant, and stores powered by Shopify are PCI compliant by default, which helps keep payment information secure.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-6; heading: Can I use my own domain name with Shopify?; content: Yes. You can use a domain you already own, or buy a new one. Every Shopify store also comes with a free myshopify.com address, and Shopify helps keep your site secure automatically.

If you already have a domain, you can keep it where you bought it and simply connect it to Shopify—or move it to Shopify so everything is managed in one place.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-7; heading: Do I get web hosting with Shopify?; content: Yes. Shopify includes secure commerce hosting with your Shopify plan, so you don't need to buy separate hosting. Shopify also includes unlimited bandwidth (no bandwidth fees) and provides a free TLS/SSL certificate for domains you add to Shopify.

Additionally, you can use the Buy Button sales channel to embed buy buttons on an external website or blog, and let customers check out using Shopify Checkout.

list: questions; question: How much does Shopify POS cost?; answer:

The total cost of Shopify POS is a combination of your plan, transaction fees, and POS Pro locations.

Your plan is the foundation for your account. It gives you access to point of sale, online sales, payments processing, marketing, analytics, shipping tools, and more.

Your transaction fees are a percentage automatically debited from each sale made through Shopify. Transaction fees will depend on the plan you choose.

POS Pro is the subscription for your retail locations. It gives you access to advanced POS features such as staff, inventory, and customer relationship management at select locations. We recommend POS Pro locations for businesses that have a lot of foot traffic, multiple tiers of staff, or a large inventory catalog. Shopify POS Pro is an additional $89 USD/month billed yearly for each location.

list: questions; question: Are there upfront costs to sell with Shopify POS?; answer:

There are a few things businesses need to set up a new POS. To start with Shopify POS, you'll need a smartphone or tablet and a Shopify card reader.

You may also choose to add hardware accessories to complete your POS setup. Build out your checkout counter with Shopify's flexible iPad stand and compatible hardware accessories like barcode scanners, cash drawers, receipt printers, and more. Browse Shopify hardware.

Bringing your own hardware accessories? Check if they're compatible.

list: questions; question: What's the difference between in-person selling features included with your paid plan, and POS Pro?; answer:

These are the feature options for your retail stores.

Casual in-person selling features are included with every Shopify paid plan. With what's included, you can take in-person payments, capture basic customer information, and accept limited returns and exchanges.

POS Pro is the upgrade for your retail locations and it costs $89 USD/month/location. On POS Pro, you get advanced features designed for businesses selling from a permanent retail location.

The Pro subscription adds the following features:

  • Unlimited POS logins for staff
  • More control over staff permissions
  • Rich customer profiles and lifetime value reporting
  • Faster workflows for discounts, exchanges, stock transfers, and in-store pickups
  • Deeper insights about product performance with in-depth inventory reporting

If your retail business sees a lot of foot traffic, has multiple levels of staff, or carries an extensive product catalog, we recommend POS Pro for your locations.

list: questions; question: How much does Shopify POS cost?; answer:

The total cost of Shopify POS is a combination of your plan, transaction fees, and POS Pro locations.

Your plan is the foundation for your account. It gives you access to point of sale, online sales, payments processing, marketing, analytics, shipping tools, and more.

Your transaction fees are a percentage automatically debited from each sale made through Shopify. Transaction fees will depend on the plan you choose.

POS Pro is the subscription for your retail locations. It gives you access to advanced POS features such as staff, inventory, and customer relationship management at select locations. We recommend POS Pro locations for businesses that have a lot of foot traffic, multiple tiers of staff, or a large inventory catalog. Shopify POS Pro is an additional $129 AUD/month billed yearly for each location.

list: questions; question: Are there upfront costs to sell with Shopify POS?; answer:

There are a few things businesses need to set up a new POS. To start with Shopify POS, you'll need a smartphone or tablet and a Shopify card reader.

You may also choose to add hardware accessories to complete your POS setup. Build out your checkout counter with Shopify's flexible iPad stand and compatible hardware accessories like barcode scanners, cash drawers, receipt printers, and more. Browse Shopify hardware.

Bringing your own hardware accessories? Check if they're compatible.

list: questions; question: What's the difference between in-person selling features included with your paid plan, and POS Pro?; answer:

These are the feature options for your retail stores.

Casual in-person selling features are included with every Shopify paid plan. With what's included, you can take in-person payments, capture basic customer information, and accept limited returns and exchanges.

POS Pro is the upgrade for your retail locations and it costs $129 AUD/month/location. On POS Pro, you get advanced features designed for businesses selling from a permanent retail location.

The Pro subscription adds the following features:

  • Unlimited POS logins for staff
  • More control over staff permissions
  • Rich customer profiles and lifetime value reporting
  • Faster workflows for discounts, exchanges, stock transfers, and in-store pickups
  • Deeper insights about product performance with in-depth inventory reporting

If your retail business sees a lot of foot traffic, has multiple levels of staff, or carries an extensive product catalog, we recommend POS Pro for your locations.

list: questions; question: Can I sell online with Shopify?; answer: Yes, all plans come with the ability to sell online. Depending on the plan you choose, with Shopify you can build and manage a website and sell on social media and online marketplaces. Learn more about online plans.

list: questions; question: How much does Shopify POS cost?; answer:

The total cost of Shopify POS is a combination of your plan, transaction fees, and POS Pro locations.

Your plan is the foundation for your account. It gives you access to point of sale, online sales, payments processing, marketing, analytics, shipping tools, and more.

Your transaction fees are a percentage automatically debited from each sale made through Shopify. Transaction fees will depend on the plan you choose.

POS Pro is the subscription for your retail locations. It gives you access to advanced POS features such as staff, inventory, and customer relationship management at select locations. We recommend POS Pro locations for businesses that have a lot of foot traffic, multiple tiers of staff, or a large inventory catalog. Shopify POS Pro is an additional $119 CAD/month billed yearly for each location.

list: questions; question: Are there upfront costs to sell with Shopify POS?; answer:

There are a few things businesses need to set up a new POS. To start with Shopify POS, you'll need a smartphone or tablet and a Shopify card reader.

You may also choose to add hardware accessories to complete your POS setup. Build out your checkout counter with Shopify's flexible iPad stand and compatible hardware accessories like barcode scanners, cash drawers, receipt printers, and more. Browse Shopify hardware.

Bringing your own hardware accessories? Check if they're compatible.

list: questions; question: What's the difference between in-person selling features included with your paid plan, and POS Pro?; answer:

These are the feature options for your retail stores.

Casual in-person selling features are included with every Shopify paid plan. With what's included, you can take in-person payments, capture basic customer information, and accept limited returns and exchanges.

POS Pro is the upgrade for your retail locations and it costs $119 CAD/month/location. On POS Pro, you get advanced features designed for businesses selling from a permanent retail location.

The Pro subscription adds the following features:

  • Unlimited POS logins for staff
  • More control over staff permissions
  • Rich customer profiles and lifetime value reporting
  • Faster workflows for discounts, exchanges, stock transfers, and in-store pickups
  • Deeper insights about product performance with in-depth inventory reporting

If your retail business sees a lot of foot traffic, has multiple levels of staff, or carries an extensive product catalog, we recommend POS Pro for your locations.

list: questions; question: Can I sell online with Shopify?; answer: Yes, all plans come with the ability to sell online. Depending on the plan you choose, with Shopify you can build and manage a website and sell on social media and online marketplaces. Learn more about online plans.

بالإضافة إلى ذلك، يمكنك اختيار إضافة باقة POS Pro إلى اشتراكك للاستمتاع بميزات نقاط بيع متقدمة مثل أدوار وصلاحيات الموظفين، وعمليات الاستبدال، وخيارات مرنة للاستلام من المتجر والتوصيل للعملاء.

list: apyDisclaimer; heading: تطبيق Shopify Bill Pay مقدم من ; description: إن Shopify شركة تكنولوجيا، وليست بنكًا. نحن نتعاون مع Stripe Payments Company لتقديم خدمات تحويل الأموال وخدمات الحسابات، مع الاحتفاظ بالأموال لدى Fifth Third Bank N.A.، وهو عضو في المؤسسة الفيدرالية لتأمين الودائع (FDIC). تُدعم بطاقات Shopify Balance Visa® التجارية بواسطة Stripe وتُصدر من قِبل Celtic Bank بموجب ترخيص من شركة Visa U.S.A. list: list; text: يُعد معدل أرباح Balance بمثابة مكافأة مقدمة من Shopify وليس فائدة. هذا المعدل متغير، ويخضع للتغيير دون إشعار مسبق، وهو دقيق اعتبارًا من ٢٩ أكتوبر ٢٠٢٦. تتراكم المكافأة يوميًا وتُدفع شهريًا في شكل رصيد يُضاف إلى حساب Balance الخاص بك. قد تُطبق حدود ACH. راجع شروط المكافآت. تُكافأ المتاجر المشتركة في خطة Shopify Plus بنسبة ٣٫٥٤٪؜، بينما تحصل جميع الخطط الأخرى على نسبة ٢٫٥٢٪؜.

list: list; text: يشير "الاسترداد النقدي" إلى المكافآت المُكتسبة كنسبة خصم على المشتريات المؤهلة. احصل على استرداد نقدي بنسبة 3% يُضاف كرصيد إلى كشف الحساب على ما يصل إلى 250,000 دولار أمريكي من المشتريات السنوية المؤهلة ضمن فئة الإنفاق الشهري الأعلى لديك—سواء كانت في التسويق، أو معالجة الطلبات، أو البيع بالجملة، واسترداد نقدي بنسبة 1% لما يتجاوز ذلك. واحصل على استرداد نقدي بنسبة 1% على فئتي الإنفاق الأخريين. تُطبق بعض القيود. راجع شروط البرنامج لمعرفة التفاصيل. افتراضيًا، يتم إدراجك لدفع رصيد كشف حسابك بالكامل عبر خصم تلقائي من حسابك البنكي المخصص خلال شهر واحد لتجنب الرسوم. ويمكنك التبديل إلى سداد مدفوعات يومية من مبيعاتك للحصول على مهلة تصل إلى 10 أشهر لسداد رصيد كشف الحساب بالكامل، مقابل رسوم. وإذا لم يتم استلام الدفعة بالكامل خلال 10 أشهر، ستُطبق رسوم تأخير شهرية بنسبة 2% على رصيدك المتأخر المستحق.

list: questions; question: ما هي تكلفة Shopify POS؟; answer:

التكلفة الإجمالية لـ Shopify POS هي مزيج من باقتك، ورسوم المعاملات، ومواقع POS Pro.

باقتك هي الأساس لحسابك. فهي تمنحك إمكانية الوصول إلى نقطة البيع، والمبيعات عبر الإنترنت، ومعالجة المدفوعات، والتسويق، والتحليلات، وأدوات الشحن، والمزيد.

رسوم معاملاتك هي نسبة مئوية تُخصم تلقائيًا من كل عملية بيع تتم من خلال Shopify. تعتمد رسوم المعاملات على الباقة التي تختارها.

POS Pro هو الاشتراك الخاص بمواقع البيع بالتجزئة لديك. وهو يتيح لك الوصول إلى ميزات POS المتقدمة مثل إدارة الموظفين، والمخزون، وعلاقات العملاء في مواقع محددة. نوصي بمواقع POS Pro للأنشطة التجارية التي تشهد حركة إقبال كبيرة، أو لديها مستويات متعددة من الموظفين، أو كتالوج مخزون كبير. تبلغ تكلفة Shopify POS Pro مبلغًا إضافيًا قدره ‏٨٩ US$ USD/الشهر يُدفع سنويًا لكل موقع.

list: questions; question: هل توجد تكاليف مسبقة للبيع باستخدام Shopify POS؟; answer:

هناك بعض الأشياء التي تحتاجها الأنشطة التجارية لإعداد نظام POS جديد. للبدء باستخدام Shopify POS، ستحتاج إلى هاتف ذكي أو جهاز لوحي وقارئ بطاقات Shopify.

يمكنك أيضًا اختيار إضافة ملحقات الأجهزة لإكمال إعداد POS الخاص بك. جهّز كاونتر الدفع الخاص بك بحامل iPad المرن من Shopify وملحقات الأجهزة المتوافقة مثل ماسحات الباركود، وأدراج النقود، وطابعات الإيصالات، والمزيد. تصفح أجهزة Shopify.

هل ستجلب ملحقات الأجهزة الخاصة بك؟ تحقق مما إذا كانت متوافقة.

list: questions; question: ما الفرق بين ميزات البيع الشخصي المتضمنة في باقتك المدفوعة ونظام POS Pro؟; answer:

هذه هي خيارات الميزات لمتاجر البيع بالتجزئة الخاصة بك.

تُعد ميزات البيع الشخصي العادي متضمنة مع كل باقة Shopify مدفوعة. من خلال ما هو متضمن، يمكنك تلقي المدفوعات شخصيًا، وجمع المعلومات الأساسية للعملاء، وقبول عمليات الإرجاع والاستبدال المحدودة.

نظام POS Pro هو ترقية لمواقع البيع بالتجزئة الخاصة بك وتبلغ تكلفته ‏٨٩ US$ USD/الشهر/الموقع. مع POS Pro، تحصل على ميزات متقدمة مصممة للأنشطة التجارية التي تبيع من موقع بيع بالتجزئة دائم.

يضيف اشتراك Pro الميزات التالية:

  • تسجيلات دخول غير محدودة للموظفين إلى POS
  • تحكم أكبر في أذونات الموظفين
  • ملفات تعريف غنية للعملاء وتقارير القيمة الدائمة
  • سير عمل أسرع للخصومات، وعمليات الاستبدال، وعمليات نقل المخزون، وعمليات الاستلام من المتجر
  • رؤى أعمق حول أداء المنتجات مع تقارير مخزون تفصيلية

إذا كان نشاطك التجاري للبيع بالتجزئة يشهد حركة إقبال كبيرة، أو لديه مستويات متعددة من الموظفين، أو يضم كتالوج منتجات شامل، فإننا نوصي بنظام POS Pro لمواقعك.

list: questions; question: هل يمكنني البيع عبر الإنترنت باستخدام Shopify؟; answer: نعم، تأتي جميع الباقات مع إمكانية البيع عبر الإنترنت. واعتمادًا على الباقة التي تختارها، يمكنك مع Shopify بناء موقع ويب وإدارته والبيع على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي والأسواق الإلكترونية. تعرف على المزيد حول باقات البيع عبر الإنترنت.

list: questions; question: How much does Shopify POS cost?; answer:

The total cost of Shopify POS is a combination of your plan, transaction fees, and POS Pro locations.

Your plan is the foundation for your account. It gives you access to point of sale, online sales, payments processing, marketing, analytics, shipping tools, and more.

Your transaction fees are a percentage automatically debited from each sale made through Shopify. Transaction fees will depend on the plan you choose.

POS Pro is the subscription for your retail locations. It gives you access to advanced POS features such as staff, inventory, and customer relationship management at select locations. We recommend POS Pro locations for businesses that have a lot of foot traffic, multiple tiers of staff, or a large inventory catalog. Shopify POS Pro is an additional US$89 USD/month billed yearly for each location.

list: questions; question: Are there upfront costs to sell with Shopify POS?; answer:

There are a few things businesses need to set up a new POS. To start with Shopify POS, you'll need a smartphone or tablet and a Shopify card reader.

You may also choose to add hardware accessories to complete your POS setup. Build out your checkout counter with Shopify's flexible iPad stand and compatible hardware accessories like barcode scanners, cash drawers, receipt printers, and more. Browse Shopify hardware.

Bringing your own hardware accessories? Check if they're compatible.

list: questions; question: What's the difference between in-person selling features included with your paid plan, and POS Pro?; answer:

These are the feature options for your retail stores.

Casual in-person selling features are included with every Shopify paid plan. With what's included, you can take in-person payments, capture basic customer information, and accept limited returns and exchanges.

POS Pro is the upgrade for your retail locations and it costs US$89 USD/month/location. On POS Pro, you get advanced features designed for businesses selling from a permanent retail location.

The Pro subscription adds the following features:

  • Unlimited POS logins for staff
  • More control over staff permissions
  • Rich customer profiles and lifetime value reporting
  • Faster workflows for discounts, exchanges, stock transfers, and in-store pickups
  • Deeper insights about product performance with in-depth inventory reporting

If your retail business sees a lot of foot traffic, has multiple levels of staff, or carries an extensive product catalog, we recommend POS Pro for your locations.

list: questions; question: Can I sell online with Shopify?; answer: Yes, all plans come with the ability to sell online. Depending on the plan you choose, with Shopify you can build and manage a website and sell on social media and online marketplaces. Learn more about online plans.

list: accordionItems; id: pricing-faq-1; heading: How much does Shopify cost?; content: Shopify starts with a free 3-day trial—no credit card required. After your trial, most plans start at just €1 per month for the first 3 months, then switch to standard monthly pricing.

Additionally, you can choose to add POS Pro to your subscription for more advanced point of sale features like staff roles and permissions, exchanges, and flexible customer pickup and delivery options.

list: list; text: "Cashback" refers to rewards earned as a percentage discount on eligible purchases. Earn 3% cashback as a statement credit on up to US$250,000 of annual eligible purchases in your monthly top spend category—either marketing, fulfillment, or wholesale, and 1% cashback thereafter. Earn 1% cashback on the other two spend categories. Restrictions apply. See Program Terms for details. By default, you are opted in to paying your full statement balance by an automatic debit from your designated bank account within 1 month to avoid fees. You have the option to switch to making daily payments from your sales and take up to 10 months to pay your full statement balance, for a fee. If payment is not received in full within 10 months, a 2% monthly late fee will apply to your past-due balance.

list: list; text: Offers to apply do not guarantee funding. All merchant cash advances in Ireland through Shopify Capital are issued by Youlend. list: questions; question: How much does Shopify POS cost?; answer:

The total cost of Shopify POS is a combination of your plan, transaction fees, and POS Pro locations.

Your plan is the foundation for your account. It gives you access to point of sale, online sales, payments processing, marketing, analytics, shipping tools, and more.

Your transaction fees are a percentage automatically debited from each sale made through Shopify. Transaction fees will depend on the plan you choose.

POS Pro is the subscription for your retail locations. It gives you access to advanced POS features such as staff, inventory, and customer relationship management at select locations. We recommend POS Pro locations for businesses that have a lot of foot traffic, multiple tiers of staff, or a large inventory catalog. Shopify POS Pro is an additional €79 EUR/month billed yearly for each location.

list: questions; question: Are there upfront costs to sell with Shopify POS?; answer:

There are a few things businesses need to set up a new POS. To start with Shopify POS, you'll need a smartphone or tablet and a Shopify card reader.

You may also choose to add hardware accessories to complete your POS setup. Build out your checkout counter with Shopify's flexible iPad stand and compatible hardware accessories like barcode scanners, cash drawers, receipt printers, and more. Browse Shopify hardware.

Bringing your own hardware accessories? Check if they're compatible.

list: questions; question: What's the difference between in-person selling features included with your paid plan, and POS Pro?; answer:

These are the feature options for your retail stores.

Casual in-person selling features are included with every Shopify paid plan. With what's included, you can take in-person payments, capture basic customer information, and accept limited returns and exchanges.

POS Pro is the upgrade for your retail locations and it costs €79 EUR/month/location. On POS Pro, you get advanced features designed for businesses selling from a permanent retail location.

The Pro subscription adds the following features:

  • Unlimited POS logins for staff
  • More control over staff permissions
  • Rich customer profiles and lifetime value reporting
  • Faster workflows for discounts, exchanges, stock transfers, and in-store pickups
  • Deeper insights about product performance with in-depth inventory reporting

If your retail business sees a lot of foot traffic, has multiple levels of staff, or carries an extensive product catalog, we recommend POS Pro for your locations.

list: questions; question: How much does Shopify POS cost?; answer:

The total cost of Shopify POS is a combination of your plan, transaction fees, and POS Pro locations.

Your plan is the foundation for your account. It gives you access to point of sale, online sales, payments processing, marketing, analytics, shipping tools, and more.

Your transaction fees are a percentage automatically debited from each sale made through Shopify. Transaction fees will depend on the plan you choose.

POS Pro is the subscription for your retail locations. It gives you access to advanced POS features such as staff, inventory, and customer relationship management at select locations. We recommend POS Pro locations for businesses that have a lot of foot traffic, multiple tiers of staff, or a large inventory catalog. Shopify POS Pro is an additional ₹7,000 INR/month billed yearly for each location.

list: questions; question: Are there upfront costs to sell with Shopify POS?; answer:

There are a few things businesses need to set up a new POS. To start with Shopify POS, you'll need a smartphone or tablet and a Shopify card reader.

You may also choose to add hardware accessories to complete your POS setup. Build out your checkout counter with Shopify's flexible iPad stand and compatible hardware accessories like barcode scanners, cash drawers, receipt printers, and more. Browse Shopify hardware.

Bringing your own hardware accessories? Check if they're compatible.

list: questions; question: What's the difference between in-person selling features included with your paid plan, and POS Pro?; answer:

These are the feature options for your retail stores.

Casual in-person selling features are included with every Shopify paid plan. With what's included, you can take in-person payments, capture basic customer information, and accept limited returns and exchanges.

POS Pro is the upgrade for your retail locations and it costs ₹7,000 INR/month/location. On POS Pro, you get advanced features designed for businesses selling from a permanent retail location.

The Pro subscription adds the following features:

  • Unlimited POS logins for staff
  • More control over staff permissions
  • Rich customer profiles and lifetime value reporting
  • Faster workflows for discounts, exchanges, stock transfers, and in-store pickups
  • Deeper insights about product performance with in-depth inventory reporting

If your retail business sees a lot of foot traffic, has multiple levels of staff, or carries an extensive product catalog, we recommend POS Pro for your locations.

list: questions; question: Can I sell online with Shopify?; answer: Yes, all plans come with the ability to sell online. Depending on the plan you choose, with Shopify you can build and manage a website and sell on social media and online marketplaces. Learn more about online plans.

list: questions; question: How much does Shopify POS cost?; answer:

The total cost of Shopify POS is a combination of your plan, transaction fees, and POS Pro locations.

Your plan is the foundation for your account. It gives you access to point of sale, online sales, payments processing, marketing, analytics, shipping tools, and more.

Your transaction fees are a percentage automatically debited from each sale made through Shopify. Transaction fees will depend on the plan you choose.

POS Pro is the subscription for your retail locations. It gives you access to advanced POS features such as staff, inventory, and customer relationship management at select locations. We recommend POS Pro locations for businesses that have a lot of foot traffic, multiple tiers of staff, or a large inventory catalog. Shopify POS Pro is an additional 920 kr NOK/month billed yearly for each location.

list: questions; question: Are there upfront costs to sell with Shopify POS?; answer:

You may also choose to add hardware accessories to complete your POS setup. Build out your checkout counter with Shopify's flexible iPad stand and compatible hardware accessories like barcode scanners, cash drawers, receipt printers, and more. Browse Shopify hardware.

Bringing your own hardware accessories? Check if they're compatible.

list: questions; question: What's the difference between in-person selling features included with your paid plan, and POS Pro?; answer:

These are the feature options for your retail stores.

Casual in-person selling features are included with every Shopify paid plan. With what's included, you can take in-person payments, capture basic customer information, and accept limited returns and exchanges.

POS Pro is the upgrade for your retail locations and it costs 920 kr NOK/month/location. On POS Pro, you get advanced features designed for businesses selling from a permanent retail location.

The Pro subscription adds the following features:

  • Unlimited POS logins for staff
  • More control over staff permissions
  • Rich customer profiles and lifetime value reporting
  • Faster workflows for discounts, exchanges, stock transfers, and in-store pickups
  • Deeper insights about product performance with in-depth inventory reporting

If your retail business sees a lot of foot traffic, has multiple levels of staff, or carries an extensive product catalog, we recommend POS Pro for your locations.

list: questions; question: هل توجد تكاليف مسبقة للبيع باستخدام Shopify POS؟; answer:

هناك بعض الأشياء التي تحتاجها الأنشطة التجارية لإعداد نظام POS جديد. للبدء باستخدام Shopify POS، ستحتاج إلى هاتف ذكي أو جهاز لوحي وقارئ بطاقات Shopify.

يمكنك أيضًا اختيار إضافة ملحقات الأجهزة لإكمال إعداد POS الخاص بك. جهّز كاونتر الدفع الخاص بك بحامل iPad المرن من Shopify وملحقات الأجهزة المتوافقة مثل ماسحات الباركود، وأدراج النقود، وطابعات الإيصالات، والمزيد. تصفح أجهزة Shopify.

هل ستجلب ملحقات الأجهزة الخاصة بك؟ تحقق مما إذا كانت متوافقة.

list: questions; question: هل يمكنني البيع عبر الإنترنت باستخدام Shopify؟; answer: نعم، تأتي جميع الباقات مع إمكانية البيع عبر الإنترنت. واعتمادًا على الباقة التي تختارها، يمكنك مع Shopify بناء موقع ويب وإدارته والبيع على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي والأسواق الإلكترونية. تعرف على المزيد حول باقات البيع عبر الإنترنت.

list: questions; question: How much does Shopify POS cost?; answer:

The total cost of Shopify POS is a combination of your plan, transaction fees, and POS Pro locations.

Your plan is the foundation for your account. It gives you access to point of sale, online sales, payments processing, marketing, analytics, shipping tools, and more.

Your transaction fees are a percentage automatically debited from each sale made through Shopify. Transaction fees will depend on the plan you choose.

POS Pro is the subscription for your retail locations. It gives you access to advanced POS features such as staff, inventory, and customer relationship management at select locations. We recommend POS Pro locations for businesses that have a lot of foot traffic, multiple tiers of staff, or a large inventory catalog. Shopify POS Pro is an additional $129 SGD/month billed yearly for each location.

list: questions; question: Are there upfront costs to sell with Shopify POS?; answer:

There are a few things businesses need to set up a new POS. To start with Shopify POS, you'll need a smartphone or tablet and a Shopify card reader.

You may also choose to add hardware accessories to complete your POS setup. Build out your checkout counter with Shopify's flexible iPad stand and compatible hardware accessories like barcode scanners, cash drawers, receipt printers, and more. Browse Shopify hardware.

Bringing your own hardware accessories? Check if they're compatible.

list: questions; question: What's the difference between in-person selling features included with your paid plan, and POS Pro?; answer:

These are the feature options for your retail stores.

Casual in-person selling features are included with every Shopify paid plan. With what's included, you can take in-person payments, capture basic customer information, and accept limited returns and exchanges.

POS Pro is the upgrade for your retail locations and it costs $129 SGD/month/location. On POS Pro, you get advanced features designed for businesses selling from a permanent retail location.

The Pro subscription adds the following features:

  • Unlimited POS logins for staff
  • More control over staff permissions
  • Rich customer profiles and lifetime value reporting
  • Faster workflows for discounts, exchanges, stock transfers, and in-store pickups
  • Deeper insights about product performance with in-depth inventory reporting

If your retail business sees a lot of foot traffic, has multiple levels of staff, or carries an extensive product catalog, we recommend POS Pro for your locations.

tag: p; text: "Cashback" refers to rewards earned as a percentage discount on eligible purchases. Earn 1% cashback on the other two spend categories. Restrictions apply. See Program Terms for details. By default, you are opted in to paying your full statement balance by an automatic debit from your designated bank account within 1 month to avoid fees. You have the option to switch to making daily payments from your sales and take up to 10 months to pay your full statement balance, for a fee. tag: h2; text: FAQs
tag: h3; text: What is Shopify and how does it work?

tag: div; text: Shopify is an all-in-one commerce platform that lets you create an online store, accept payments, and sell on social channels and in person—all from one dashboard. Build a professional storefront, manage products and inventory, process orders and shipping, automate marketing and SEO, analyze sales, and run your business from web or mobile—no coding required.
tag: h3; text: How much does Shopify cost?

tag: div; text: Shopify starts with a free 3-day trial—no credit card required. After your trial, most plans start at just $1 per month for the first 3 months, then switch to standard monthly pricing.Additionally, you can choose to add POS Pro to your subscription for more advanced point of sale features like staff roles and permissions, exchanges, and flexible customer pickup and delivery options.
tag: h3; text: Can I cancel or change my subscription anytime?

tag: div; text: Yes. If you ever decide that Shopify isn't the best commerce platform for your business, simply cancel your account.If you choose a 1- or 3-year Plus subscription, you can cancel when your term commitment expires.
tag: h3; text: Are there any additional fees?

tag: div; text: There are no setup fees on any of our plans.Third-party transaction fees may apply when you use a third-party payment provider (instead of Shopify Payments). The rate depends on your plan.Shopify charges a small fee to allow you to accept major credit cards, such as Visa and Mastercard, as payment in your store. These fees vary depending on the plan that you choose.
tag: h3; text: In what countries can I use Shopify?

tag: div; text: Shopify is available in nearly every country in the world. Some features vary by country—for example, Shopify Payments is available only in certain countries—so pricing and payment options can differ depending on where your business is based.
tag: h3; text: Is Shopify PCI Compliant or PCI Certified?
tag: div; text: Yes. Shopify is certified Level 1 PCI DSS compliant, and stores powered by Shopify are PCI compliant by default, which helps keep payment information secure.
tag: h3; text: Can I use my own domain name with Shopify?

tag: div; text: Yes. You can use a domain you already own, or buy a new one. Every Shopify store also comes with a free myshopify.com address, and Shopify helps keep your site secure automatically.If you already have a domain, you can keep it where you bought it and simply connect it to Shopify—or move it to Shopify so everything is managed in one place.
tag: h3; text: Do I get web hosting with Shopify?

tag: div; text: Yes. Shopify includes secure commerce hosting with your Shopify plan, so you don't need to buy separate hosting. Shopify also includes unlimited bandwidth (no bandwidth fees) and provides a free TLS/SSL certificate for domains you add to Shopify.Additionally, you can use the Buy Button sales channel to embed buy buttons on an external website or blog, and let customers check out using Shopify Checkout.

tag: p; text: The Balance earnings rate is a reward provided by Shopify and is not interest. The rate is variable, subject to change without notice, and accurate as of September 28, 2026. The reward accrues daily and is paid monthly in the form of a credit to your Balance account. ACH limits may apply. See Reward Terms. Stores on Shopify Plus are rewarded with 3.54%, and all other plans receive 2.52%.; links: [text: Reward Terms; href: https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/finance/shopify-balance/rewards/earning-rewards]

tag: p; text: "Cashback" refers to rewards earned as a percentage discount on eligible purchases. Earn 3% cashback as a statement credit on up to US$250,000 of annual eligible purchases in your monthly top spend category—either marketing, fulfillment, or wholesale, and 1% cashback thereafter. Earn 1% cashback on the other two spend categories. Restrictions apply. See Program Terms for details. By default, you are opted in to paying your full statement balance by an automatic debit from your designated bank account within 1 month to avoid fees. You have the option to switch to making daily payments from your sales and take up to 10 months to pay your full statement balance, for a fee. If payment is not received in full within 10 months, a 2% monthly late fee will apply to your past-due balance.; links: [text: Program Terms; href: /legal/shopify-credit-program-terms]

tag: p; text: Offers to apply do not guarantee funding. Shopify Capital loans are repaid based on a percentage of daily sales. The maximum repayment term is 18 months, and 2 minimum payments apply. The actual time period within which the loan is repaid may be less than 18 months. Funds through Shopify Capital are added to your account in as little as two business days, if approved.

interface: RenderExtensionTargets; target: pos.home.tile.render; doc: Renders a single interactive tile component on the POS home screen's smart grid. The tile appears once during home screen initialization and remains persistent until navigation occurs. Use this target for high-frequency actions, status displays, or entry points to workflows that merchants need daily. Extensions at this target can dynamically update properties like enabled state and badge values in response to cart changes or device conditions. Tiles typically invoke `shopify.action.presentModal()` to launch the companion modal for complete workflows. Tiles can also open the connected cash drawer through the Cash Drawer API.; type: RenderExtension<StandardApi<'pos.home.tile.render'> & ActionApi & CartApi & CashDrawerApi, SmartGridComponents>

interface: RenderExtensionTargets; target: pos.home.modal.render; doc: Renders a full-screen modal interface launched from smart grid tiles. The modal appears when users tap a companion tile. Use this target for complete workflow experiences that require more space and functionality than the tile interface provides, such as multi-step processes, detailed information displays, or complex user interactions. Extensions at this target support full navigation hierarchies with multiple screens, scroll views, and interactive components to handle sophisticated workflows, and can open the connected cash drawer through the Cash Drawer API.; type: RenderExtension<ActionTargetApi<'pos.home.modal.render'> & CartApi & CashDrawerApi, BasicComponents>

interface: RenderExtensionTargets; target: pos.cart.line-item-details.action.render; doc: Renders a full-screen modal interface launched from cart line item menu items. Use this target for complex line item workflows that require forms, multi-step processes, or detailed information displays beyond what a simple button can provide. Extensions at this target have access to detailed line item data through the Cart Line Item API and support workflows with multiple screens, navigation, and interactive components. Action render targets are themselves the modal destination, so the Action API (`shopify.action.presentModal()`) is not available here; use the Navigation API for in-workflow navigation.; type: RenderExtension<ActionTargetApi<'pos.cart.line-item-details.action.render'> & CartApi & CartLineItemApi, BasicComponents>
